definition_zh: 事实上；竟然；实际上；真正地；目前（旧义）；现实中；插入语用法；其实（弱化否定）
definition_en: used to correct a mistaken belief, to show surprise, to contrast reality with expectation, or to state what is genuinely true
core_image: 伸手掀开桌布，底下摆着的才是真正的那张桌面
scene: 朋友都以为他还在国外，其实他早已回到这座城市。He is actually living in this city now.
sceneCN: 这里 actually 是「事实上、其实」（第 1 个义项：纠正别人的误解）；句意为其实他现在就住在这座城市。

pos.zh: 副词：事实上；竟然；实际上；真正地

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉 -ly 回到形容词形式，义为「实际的；真实的」
由 actual 加名词后缀 -ity 构成，义为「现实性；实际情况」
由 actual 加动词后缀 -ize 构成，义为「实现；使成为现实」
由 actualize 加名词后缀 -ation 构成，义为「实现；现实化」

senses.title: Correcting a mistaken belief
senses.definition: used to correct something that someone believes or has just said, because it is not true
senses.definitionCN: 用于纠正某人相信或刚刚说出的错误看法，因为那并不符合事实
senses.example: Actually, the train leaves at nine, not at eight.
senses.exampleCN: 事实上，火车是九点开，不是八点。
senses.why: The core image lifts the tablecloth: what was assumed is replaced by what is really underneath.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是掀开桌布：原先以为的东西被底下真正的实情替换。

senses.title: Expressing surprise at a fact
senses.definition: used to express surprise that something is true or has happened, especially when it seems unlikely
senses.definitionCN: 用于表达对某事实或某事发生的意外，尤其是当它显得不太可能时
senses.example: He actually finished the whole race without stopping.
senses.exampleCN: 他竟然一路没停跑完了全程。
senses.why: Under the cloth lies something better or stranger than expected, and the speaker points at it in surprise.
senses.whyCN: 桌布底下藏着比预期更好或更奇怪的东西，说话人惊讶地指着它。

senses.title: Reality contrasted with expectation
senses.definition: used to contrast what really happens with what was expected, planned or claimed
senses.definitionCN: 用于把真正发生的情况与原先的预期、计划或说法相对比
senses.example: The task looked easy but was actually quite hard.
senses.exampleCN: 这项任务看着容易，实际上却相当难。
senses.why: Expectation is the cloth; reality is the table under it, and the two do not match.
senses.whyCN: 预期是那块桌布，现实是布下的桌面，两者并不一致。

senses.title: Emphasizing that something is genuinely true
senses.definition: used to emphasize that a statement is true, often more strongly than the plainer word really
senses.definitionCN: 用于强调某说法确实成立，语气常比普通的 really 更重
senses.example: She actually enjoys walking in cold rain.
senses.exampleCN: 她真的喜欢在冷雨里走路。
senses.why: The lifted cloth proves the thing is not pretended or imagined but present in fact.
senses.whyCN: 掀开的桌布证明这件事不是假装或想象，而是确实摆在眼前。

senses.title: At the present time, in older usage
senses.definition: in older English, at the present time or just now, a sense that is now rare
senses.definitionCN: 在较旧的英语中表示「目前、此刻」，这一义项如今已罕用
senses.example: The papers are actually in the hands of the committee.
senses.exampleCN: 那些文件目前正在委员会手中。
senses.why: French actuel meant present, so the early English adverb could point at the here and now.
senses.whyCN: 法语 actuel 意为「现在的」，因此早期英语副词也能指向此时此地。

senses.title: In reality rather than in theory
senses.titleCN: 现实中：与理想或理论对比
senses.definition: used to describe what happens in the real world, as opposed to what is ideal or theoretical
senses.definitionCN: 用于描述现实世界中发生的事，与理想或理论上的情形相对
senses.example: Ideals are easy to state; what people actually do is another matter.
senses.exampleCN: 理想说起来容易，人们现实中怎么做是另一回事。
senses.why: The table under the cloth is the world as it is, not the world as it should be.
senses.whyCN: 桌布下的桌面是世界的本来样子，而不是它应该有的样子。

senses.title: As a sentence opener in speech
senses.definition: used at the beginning of a sentence, often followed by a comma, to introduce a new, corrected or surprising point
senses.definitionCN: 用于句首，其后常带逗号，引出一个新的、更正性的或令人意外的要点
senses.example: Actually, there is something I have been meaning to tell you.
senses.exampleCN: 其实，有件事我一直想告诉你。
senses.why: The speaker lifts the cloth before saying anything else, announcing that the next words will revise the picture.
senses.whyCN: 说话人先掀开桌布再开口，预告接下来的话会改写原有的图景。

senses.title: Softening a disagreement or refusal
senses.definition: used to soften a disagreement, refusal or gentle correction, close in force to as a matter of fact
senses.definitionCN: 用于缓和不同意、拒绝或温和的更正，语气接近 as a matter of fact
senses.example: Actually, I would rather stay home tonight.
senses.exampleCN: 其实，今晚我更愿意待在家里。
senses.why: The correction is offered as a quiet look under the cloth, so the refusal lands softly.
senses.whyCN: 更正被当作一次轻声的掀布，让拒绝落得温和。

intro.en: Actually is the adverb of actual, a word English took from Latin through French, where it first meant what is real and present.
intro.cn: actually 是 actual 的副词形式，actual 经由法语来自拉丁语，早期义为「真实的、当下的」。

items.en: agere meant 'to do, drive, set in motion'; its participle actus gave the noun actus, 'a doing, an act'.
items.cn: agere 意为「做、驱动、使行动」，其分词形式 actus 构成名词 actus「行为、行动」。

items.en: actualis was formed on actus and meant 'of action, practical, active', not yet 'true'.
items.cn: actualis 由 actus 构成，义为「行动的、实践的、活动的」，当时还没有「真实的」这一层意思。

items.en: French actuel meant 'present, current, real', and this present-time colour entered English with the word.
items.cn: 法语 actuel 意为「现在的、当前的、真实的」，这层「当下」的色彩随词一同进入英语。

items.en: English borrowed actual in the fourteenth century with the sense 'real, existing'; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入 actual，义为「真实的、存在的」；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The adverb actually added -ly and branched into correction, surprise, contrast, emphasis and a parenthetical opener.
items.cn: 副词 actually 加上 -ly，随后分化出纠正、意外、对比、强调与句首插入语等用法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the Latin stem for act; the near-meaning group gathers expressions that also mark what is true against what is said.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁语「行动」词干构成的词；近义组收同样用来对照「真实」与「说法」的表达。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning real or existing, the base from which the adverb is formed.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「实际的、真实的」，是本词加 -ly 之前的原形。

entries.definition: A noun for the state of being real, or for real conditions as opposed to wishes.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「现实性、实际情况」，与愿望相对。

entries.definition: A verb meaning to make something real or to carry a plan out.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「实现、使成为现实」，指把计划落到实处。

entries.definition: A noun or verb for doing something; it shares the Latin stem actus with this family.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或动词，义为「行为、行动」，与本词族共享拉丁词干 actus。

entries.definition: An adverb used to emphasize truth or to ask whether something is true; more general than actually.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「真正地、真的」，也可用于追问真假，比 actually 更通用。

entries.definition: A phrase introducing a statement that corrects or adds to what was just said.
entries.definitionCN: 短语，义为「事实上」，引出更正或补充前面说法的一句话。

entries.definition: An adverb meaning sincerely or genuinely, with a warmer and more formal tone.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「真诚地、确实」，语气更温暖也更正式。

entries.definition: An adverb meaning almost or in effect, not 'in actual fact'.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「几乎、实际上等于」，并不表示「事实如此」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin stem for act and the functions the adverb performs in speech.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁「行动」词干，以及这个副词在口语中承担的功能。

normal.en: actualis came from actus, a doing: what is actual is what has really been done.
normal.cn: actualis 来自 actus「行为」：actual 就是真正做成的事。

normal.en: The -ly suffix turns the adjective into the everyday corrective adverb.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ly 把形容词变成日常用来纠正的副词。

normal.en: French actuel meant present, which explains the rare sense at the present time.
normal.cn: 法语 actuel 意为「现在的」，这解释了「目前」这一罕用义项。

normal.en: Actually at the start of a sentence works as a spoken parenthesis.
normal.cn: Actually 放在句首时，起到口语插入语的作用。

normal.en: Actually often softens a refusal, as in a polite correction of plans.
normal.cn: actually 常用来缓和拒绝，例如礼貌地更正计划。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pulling back a cloth: the table underneath is the fact, the cloth is the assumption.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把桌布掀开：下面的桌面是事实，桌布是原先的假定。

abstract.en: The same gesture serves correction and surprise, because both replace an expected picture with a real one.
abstract.cn: 同一个动作既能用于纠正也能用于意外，因为两者都是用真实图景替换预期图景。

abstract.en: When the speaker says it softly at the start of a sentence, the cloth is lifted only a little.
abstract.cn: 当说话人在句首轻声说出它时，桌布只被掀起一点点。

examples.en: Actually, the shop closes at six on Sundays.
examples.cn: 事实上，这家店周日六点关门。

examples.en: The old house is actually much larger than it looks.
examples.cn: 这座老房子实际上比看起来大得多。

examples.en: She was surprised that he actually remembered her name.
examples.cn: 他竟还记得她的名字，她很意外。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿克秋里」——阿可把桌布一掀，底下全是真情形：事实上

root: 拉丁语 actualis 由 actus（agere「做、驱动」的分词）构成，义为「行动的、实际的」；英语 actual 先表「真实的、现实的」，加 -ly 成副词，旧义「目前」可追溯到法语 actuel「现在的」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight uses of actually all lift one cloth: correction, surprise, contrast with expectation, emphatic truth, the older present-time sense, reality versus theory, the sentence-opening parenthesis, and the softened refusal.
sensesIntro.cn: actually 的八种用法都在掀同一块桌布：纠正、意外、与预期对比、强调真实、旧有的「目前」义、现实与理论之别、句首插入语，以及缓和的拒绝。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand lifts the tablecloth and the real table appears underneath.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手掀开桌布，底下真正的桌面显露出来。

branches.en: CORRECTION: the cloth is lifted to replace a wrong belief, to open a sentence, or to soften a refusal.
branches.cn: 纠正线：掀开桌布以替换错误看法、开启一句话，或缓和一次拒绝。

branches.en: SURPRISE: what is under the cloth is stranger than anyone expected.
branches.cn: 意外线：桌布底下的东西比任何人预想的都更离奇。

branches.en: CONTRAST: expectation, theory and ideals are compared with what is really there.
branches.cn: 对比线：预期、理论与理想都被拿来与真正存在的情形比较。

branches.en: TRUTH: the lifted cloth proves the thing is genuine rather than pretended.
branches.cn: 真实线：掀开的桌布证明此事为真，而非假装。

branches.en: TIME: through French actuel, the adverb once pointed at the present moment.
branches.cn: 时间线：经由法语 actuel，这个副词曾经指向此刻。

intro.en: Actually is a Latin stem plus two English suffixes; the parts below show how act grew into a family of real-world words.
intro.cn: actually 由一个拉丁词干加两个英语后缀构成；下面的条目展示 act 如何长成一个表示「现实」的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin agere, actus and actualis are all recorded, so only the deeper Indo-European origin is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 agere、actus 与 actualis 均有文献记录，只有更早的印欧来源属于重构。

items.example: The verb is the deepest layer of the family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是这一词族最深的一层。

items.example: The noun supplied the stem for actualis.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词为 actualis 提供了词干。

items.example: It entered French and then English.
items.exampleCN: 它先进入法语，再进入英语。

items.example: Act keeps the shortest form of the stem.
items.exampleCN: act 保留了这一词干最短的形式。

items.example: It is the base of the adverb.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个副词的基础形式。

items.example: It forms actualis and actual.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 actualis 与 actual。

items.example: It turns actual into actually.
items.exampleCN: 它把 actual 变成 actually。

items.example: It forms actuality.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 actuality。

definition_zh: 急性的；严重的；敏锐的；剧烈的；锐角的；高音的；关键紧急的；敏锐度
definition_en: sharp in the physical or mental sense, and by extension sudden, severe or urgently important
core_image: 一枚磨得极尖的针头，既能扎进肉里，也能刺穿一层迷雾
scene: 夜里孩子突然腹痛难忍，家人急忙送他去急诊。The doctor suspected acute appendicitis and sent him straight to surgery.
sceneCN: 这里 acute 是「急性的」（第 1 个义项：疾病突然发作）；句意为医生怀疑是急性阑尾炎，直接把他送去做手术。

pos.zh: 形容词：急性的；严重的；敏锐的；锐角的
名词：（语音）尖音符；锐音

derivatives.zh: 由本词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「敏锐地；剧烈地；强烈地」
由本词加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「敏锐；剧烈；急迫」
由拉丁词根 acu- 加名词后缀 -ity 构成，义为「敏锐度；尖锐度」
由拉丁语 acumen「尖点」借入，义为「敏锐的洞察力」

senses.title: A disease that begins suddenly
senses.definition: describing an illness or condition that starts suddenly and is often severe but short in duration
senses.definitionCN: 指疾病或病症突然发作，常较严重但持续时间较短
senses.example: He was admitted with acute appendicitis that same evening.
senses.exampleCN: 他当晚就因急性阑尾炎住进了医院。
senses.why: The image is a sharp needle point: the illness strikes at once instead of creeping in slowly.
senses.whyCN: 意象是尖锐的针尖：疾病是一下刺入，而不是慢慢蔓延。

senses.title: Serious and severe in a situation
senses.definition: used of a problem, shortage or difficulty that is very serious and demands attention
senses.definitionCN: 用于形容问题、短缺或困难极为严重，必须立即处理
senses.example: The city faces an acute shortage of nurses.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市面临护士严重短缺。
senses.why: A shortage cuts sharply into daily life, like a point pressed against a surface.
senses.whyCN: 短缺像针尖抵在表面上，尖锐地切进日常生活。

senses.title: Sharp in perception or understanding
senses.definition: able to notice, hear, see or understand things quickly and accurately
senses.definitionCN: 能迅速而准确地察觉、听见、看见或理解事物
senses.example: Her acute hearing caught the faint whistle from the yard.
senses.exampleCN: 她敏锐的听觉捕捉到了院子里微弱的口哨声。
senses.why: The sharp point is turned toward the mind: it cuts through confusion to the detail.
senses.whyCN: 尖锋转向心智：它能穿过混乱，直抵细节。

senses.title: A sharp, intense pain
senses.definition: describing pain that is strong and sharply felt rather than dull and spreading
senses.definitionCN: 形容疼痛强烈、尖锐可感，而不是沉闷扩散的
senses.example: A sudden acute pain shot through his shoulder.
senses.exampleCN: 一阵突如其来的剧痛穿过他的肩膀。
senses.why: Pain is described as a point rather than a ache: it pierces instead of pressing.
senses.whyCN: 疼痛被形容成一个点而不是一片钝痛：它是刺入而不是压迫。

senses.title: An angle smaller than a right angle
senses.definition: in geometry, describing an angle that is smaller than ninety degrees
senses.definitionCN: 几何学中，指小于直角的角
senses.example: An acute angle is sharper than a right angle.
senses.exampleCN: 锐角比直角更尖。
senses.why: The point of a needle is itself the model of a narrow, sharp corner.
senses.whyCN: 针尖本身就是狭窄尖角的最好模型。

senses.title: A high or marked accent in speech
senses.definition: in phonetics and spelling, a mark that shows a raised or stressed vowel, or a high pitch
senses.definitionCN: 语音学与拼写中表示元音升高、重读或高音的符号
senses.example: The acute accent over the final vowel marks the stress.
senses.exampleCN: 最后一个元音上的尖音符标出了重音。
senses.why: A raised pitch is a sharp rise in the voice, like a point lifted above the line.
senses.whyCN: 升高的音高是声音的一次尖起，像尖锋抬离基准线。

senses.title: Urgently important and critical
senses.definition: describing a need or situation that is critical and must be dealt with immediately
senses.definitionCN: 形容需求或局势已到紧要关头，必须立刻处理
senses.example: The refugees are in acute need of clean water.
senses.exampleCN: 难民们急需清洁饮水。
senses.why: The sharp edge separates what can wait from what cannot; acute marks the latter.
senses.whyCN: 锋刃把「可以等」与「不能等」切开，acute 标的是后者。

senses.title: The noun acuteness for sharpness
senses.definition: the quality named by acuteness, meaning sharpness of perception, feeling or intensity
senses.definitionCN: 派生名词 acuteness 所指的性质，即感知、感受或强度的尖锐程度
senses.example: The acuteness of his hearing made the noisy room unbearable.
senses.exampleCN: 他听觉的敏锐让喧闹的房间变得难以忍受。
senses.why: The adjective's point becomes a measurable quality once -ness names it.
senses.whyCN: 一旦 -ness 为它命名，形容词的尖锋就变成一种可衡量的性质。

intro.en: Acute goes back to a Latin verb for sharpening, and its sharp point was applied to disease, pain, angles, hearing and need.
intro.cn: acute 可上溯到拉丁语中表示「磨尖」的动词，其尖锋随后被用于疾病、疼痛、角度、听觉与迫切需求。

items.en: *ak- is generally reconstructed as 'sharp, pointed'; the deeper origin of the root is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧语 *ak- 表示「尖的、锐的」；这一词根更早的来源不确定。

items.en: acuere meant 'to sharpen, whet', and it also gave acus 'needle' and acies 'sharp edge'.
items.cn: acuere 意为「磨尖、磨快」，它还生出 acus「针」与 acies「锋刃」。

items.en: The participle acutus meant 'sharpened, pointed, keen', already used of pain, sound and perception.
items.cn: 分词 acutus 意为「磨尖的、尖锐的、敏锐的」，当时已用于疼痛、声音与感知。

items.en: English borrowed acute directly from Latin in the late fourteenth century; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪晚期直接从拉丁语借入 acute；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Medicine fixed the sudden-onset sense, geometry the narrow angle, and phonetics the raised accent.
items.cn: 医学固定了「突然发作」义，几何固定了「窄角」义，语音学固定了「升调符号」义。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words on the Latin root for sharp; the near-meaning group gathers words of sharpness, severity and intensity.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁「尖」词根上的词；近义组收表示尖锐、严重与强烈的词。

entries.definition: The adverb formed with -ly, meaning sharply, intensely or keenly.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 -ly 构成的副词，义为「尖锐地、剧烈地、敏锐地」。

entries.definition: The noun formed with -ness for the quality of being sharp or severe.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 -ness 构成的名词，指敏锐或剧烈的性质。

entries.definition: A noun for keen insight, from the same Latin root for sharpness.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「敏锐的洞察力」，与 acute 同出「尖」词根。

entries.definition: A medical practice of inserting needles, literally 'needle pricking', built on acus.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「针灸」，字面是「用针刺」，由 acus「针」构成，同属尖词根。

entries.definition: The everyday adjective for a fine edge or a quick mind; broader and less technical than acute.
entries.definitionCN: 日常形容词，义为「锋利的、敏锐的」，范围比 acute 更宽，技术色彩更少。

entries.definition: Adjective meaning very bad or intense, used of problems, pain and weather.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「严重的、剧烈的」，用于问题、疼痛与天气。

entries.definition: Adjective meaning eager or sharply perceptive, close to the mental sense of acute.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「热切的、敏锐的」，接近 acute 的心智义。

entries.definition: Adjective meaning very strong in degree, without the image of a point.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「强烈的、极度的」，不带「尖点」的意象。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin root for sharpening and the collocations the word appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁「磨尖」词根，以及这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: acuere is to sharpen: acute things have a point that cuts.
normal.cn: acuere 是「磨尖」：acute 的事物都有一个能切开的尖锋。

normal.en: acus is a needle, which is why acupuncture belongs to the same family.
normal.cn: acus 是「针」，所以 acupuncture 属于同一词族。

normal.en: Acute pain is sharp, while a dull ache spreads and presses.
normal.cn: acute pain 是尖锐的痛，而钝痛是扩散压迫的。

normal.en: An acute angle is narrower than a right angle, like a needle point.
normal.cn: 锐角比直角更窄，就像针尖。

normal.en: An acute shortage is one that cuts into life at once.
normal.cn: acute shortage 是立刻切进生活的严重短缺。

abstract.en: Picture a needle tip held against a sheet of paper: one push and the surface is pierced.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚针尖抵住纸面：轻轻一推，表面就被刺穿。

abstract.en: The same tip can pierce skin, fog or a confusing argument; the direction changes, the sharpness does not.
abstract.cn: 同一枚针尖可以刺穿皮肤、迷雾或混乱的论证；方向变了，尖锐不变。

abstract.en: A sudden illness and an urgent need both arrive like that one push, leaving no time to prepare.
abstract.cn: 急病与急迫的需求都像那一次推刺，让人来不及准备。

examples.en: The patient complained of acute pain in his lower back.
examples.cn: 病人诉说他下背部有剧烈疼痛。

examples.en: There is an acute shortage of housing in the capital.
examples.cn: 首都的住房严重短缺。

examples.en: Her acute sense of smell detected the gas leak at once.
examples.cn: 她敏锐的嗅觉立刻察觉到了煤气泄漏。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿Q特」——阿Q那根针特别尖：尖锐、急性

root: 拉丁语 acuere「磨尖」的分词 acutus 意为「尖锐的、敏锐的」，来自印欧词根 *ak-「尖」；同族有 acus「针」、acies「锋刃」与 acumen「尖点、洞察力」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of acute all turn one sharp point toward different surfaces: a sudden illness, a severe problem, perception, pain, an angle, a raised accent, urgent need, and the quality named acuteness.
sensesIntro.cn: acute 的八个义项都把同一枚尖锋转向不同的表面：突发疾病、严重问题、感知、疼痛、角度、升调符号、迫切需求，以及 acuteness 所指的性质。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finely sharpened needle tip that pierces whatever surface it meets.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚磨得极尖的针头，遇到什么表面就刺穿什么。

branches.en: SUDDENNESS AND URGENCY: illness and need both strike at once and allow no delay.
branches.cn: 突发与急迫线：疾病与需求都是一下刺到，不容拖延。

branches.en: SEVERITY: a shortage and a pain are both sharp enough to cut into normal life.
branches.cn: 严重线：短缺与疼痛都尖锐到足以切进正常生活。

branches.en: PERCEPTION: the point turns toward the mind and finds the smallest detail.
branches.cn: 感知线：尖锋转向心智，找到最细小的细节。

branches.en: GEOMETRY: the point itself becomes a narrow angle.
branches.cn: 几何线：尖锋本身就是一个狭窄的角。

branches.en: VOICE AND QUALITY: a raised pitch is a sharp rise, and acuteness names the property.
branches.cn: 声音与性质线：升高的音高是一次尖起，acuteness 则为这一性质命名。

intro.en: Acute keeps a Latin adjective whole; the family is completed by Latin nouns and English suffixes.
intro.cn: acute 整体保留了拉丁形容词；这一词族再由拉丁名词与英语后缀补全。

latinIntro.en: Latin acuere, acutus, acus and acumen are recorded, so only the Indo-European root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 acuere、acutus、acus 与 acumen 均有记录，只有印欧词根属于重构。

items.exampleCN: 这个词根支撑着整个词族。

items.example: It is the sharpening verb behind acute.
items.exampleCN: 它是 acute 背后的「磨尖」动词。

items.example: English took the adjective almost unchanged.
items.exampleCN: 英语几乎原样借入了这个形容词。

items.example: It survives inside acupuncture.
items.exampleCN: 它保存在 acupuncture 一词里。

items.example: The noun shows the edge rather than the point.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词展示的是锋刃而非尖点。

items.example: English borrowed it unchanged.
items.exampleCN: 英语原样借入了这个词。

items.example: It forms acutely.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 acutely。

items.example: It forms acuteness.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 acuteness。

items.example: It forms acuity.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 acuity。

definition_zh: 使适应；改编；改造；适应（不及物）；顺应变化；调整（计划）；使适合特定用途；进化适应
definition_en: to change oneself or something else so that it fits new conditions, a new form or a new purpose
core_image: 把旧衣服的袖口重新裁短改窄，让它正好贴合新的手臂
scene: 搬进山城以后，一家人慢慢习惯了那里潮湿多雾的天气。The family gradually adapted to the damp air of the mountain town.
sceneCN: 这里 adapt 是「适应」（第 4 个义项：不及物用法 adapt to）；句意为一家人渐渐适应了山城潮湿的空气。

pos.zh: 及物动词：使适应；改编；改造
不及物动词：适应；顺应变化

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀 -ation 构成，义为「适应；改编作品」
由本词加形容词后缀 -able 构成，义为「能适应的；可改编的」
由 adaptable 加名词后缀 -ity 构成，义为「适应能力」
由本词加形容词后缀 -ive 构成，义为「适应性的；有适应能力的」
由本词加名词后缀 -or 构成，义为「适配器；改编者」

senses.title: To make someone or something fit a new setting
senses.definition: to change a person, group or thing so that it can live or work well in new conditions
senses.definitionCN: 改变某人、某群体或某物，使其能在新条件下正常生活或运作
senses.example: Schools must adapt their buildings for wheelchair users.
senses.exampleCN: 学校必须改造校舍，以适应坐轮椅的人。
senses.why: The image is a sleeve taken in at the seam: the garment is altered until it fits the arm.
senses.whyCN: 意象是在接缝处收窄袖子：衣服被改动，直到贴合手臂。

senses.title: To turn a work into another form
senses.titleCN: 改编：把作品换成另一种形式
senses.definition: to change a book, play or story into a film, script, opera or other medium
senses.definitionCN: 把书、戏剧或故事改写为电影、剧本、歌剧或其他媒介
senses.example: The novel was adapted into a popular television series.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说被改编成一部很受欢迎的电视剧。
senses.why: The same material is cut and sewn again so that it fits a different body, the new medium.
senses.whyCN: 同样的布料被重新裁剪缝合，以适合另一副身躯，也就是新的媒介。

senses.title: To modify an object for a new use
senses.titleCN: 改造某物以适应新用途
senses.definition: to alter a building, tool or vehicle so that it can serve a purpose it was not designed for
senses.definitionCN: 改动建筑、工具或车辆，使它能够承担原先并非为其设计的功能
senses.example: They adapted the old barn into a small workshop.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把旧谷仓改造成一间小工坊。
senses.why: A garment made for one use is taken in and let out until it serves another.
senses.whyCN: 为一种用途做的衣服被收紧又放宽，直到能派上另一种用场。

senses.title: To become suited by changing oneself
senses.titleCN: 适应：不及物用法 adapt to
senses.definition: to change one's behaviour or expectations so as to fit a new place, climate or situation
senses.definitionCN: 改变自己的行为或期待，以适合新的地方、气候或处境
senses.example: Children often adapt quickly to a new school.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子往往很快就能适应新学校。
senses.why: Here the wearer and the garment are one: the person alters himself to fit the place.
senses.whyCN: 这里穿衣服的人与衣服合为一体：人改变自己来贴合环境。

senses.title: To respond to changing conditions
senses.definition: to adjust successfully when circumstances, demand or technology change
senses.definitionCN: 当环境、需求或技术发生变化时成功作出调整
senses.example: Small businesses had to adapt when online shopping grew.
senses.exampleCN: 网络购物兴起时，小企业不得不顺应变化。
senses.why: The seam is let out as the body grows: change is met by altering the fit.
senses.whyCN: 身体长大时接缝被放宽：以改变合身程度来应对变化。

senses.title: To alter a plan or method
senses.definition: to change a plan, schedule or method so that it still works under new circumstances
senses.definitionCN: 修改计划、日程或方法，使它在新的情况下仍然可行
senses.example: We adapted our schedule to avoid the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 我们调整了日程以避开暴风雨。
senses.why: A plan is a pattern cut in advance; adapting trims it to the actual body.
senses.whyCN: 计划是事先裁好的纸样；adapt 就是按实际身形把它修剪合适。

senses.title: To make something suitable for a particular purpose
senses.definition: to change material or a text so that it is suitable for a specific group or purpose
senses.definitionCN: 改动材料或文本，使其适合特定群体或特定用途
senses.example: The reading course is adapted for absolute beginners.
senses.exampleCN: 这套阅读课程是为零基础学习者改编的。
senses.why: The same cloth is cut to a particular measure, neither too loose nor too tight.
senses.whyCN: 同一块布被裁成特定尺寸，既不过松也不过紧。

senses.title: To become better suited through evolution
senses.definition: in biology, to develop features over generations that make a species fit its environment
senses.definitionCN: 生物学中指物种经过许多世代演化出适应其环境的特征
senses.example: Desert plants have adapted to very scarce water.
senses.exampleCN: 沙漠植物已经适应了极为稀缺的水。
senses.why: Generation by generation the species is refitted to its surroundings, as a garment is remade.
senses.whyCN: 物种一代代被重新裁剪以贴合环境，就像衣服被重做。

intro.en: Adapt is a Latin compound meaning to fit something to something else, and the root is the adjective for fit.
intro.cn: adapt 是一个拉丁语复合词，意为「使某物与另一物相合」，词根是表示「合适的」形容词。

items.en: aptus meant 'fit, suited, fastened'; its deeper origin is source uncertain, and it is not securely linked to the verb apere.
items.cn: aptus 意为「合适的、合身的、系紧的」；更早来源不确定，与动词 apere 的联系并不确凿。

items.en: aptare meant 'to fit, fasten, adjust', formed on aptus.
items.cn: aptare 意为「使合适、系紧、调整」，由 aptus 构成。

items.en: ad- plus aptare gave adaptare, 'to fit to, adjust to', with the prefix marking direction toward a goal.
items.cn: ad- 加 aptare 构成 adaptare，义为「使适合于、调整以适应」，前缀标出朝向目标的方向。

items.en: French adapter carried the word into English; the exact borrowing date is uncertain and spellings vary.
items.cn: 法语 adapter 把这个词带入英语；确切借入年代不确定，早期拼写不统一。

items.en: English extended the verb from physical fitting to books turned into films, plans trimmed to events, and species fitted to habitats.
items.cn: 英语把这个动词从实物的合身，扩展到书改成电影、计划随事件修剪、物种适应栖息地。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the Latin family for fitting; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of change to suit a new condition.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁语「使合身」词族；近义组收表示「为适应新条件而改变」的动词。

entries.definition: The noun for the process or result of adapting, or a work changed into another medium.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「适应过程；改编作品」，由本词加 -ation 构成。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning able to change in order to fit new conditions.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「能适应的、可改编的」，由本词加 -able 构成。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning having the quality of adjusting well, common in biology.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「适应性的」，常见于生物学，由本词加 -ive 构成。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning suitable or likely, from the same Latin aptus.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「恰当的、易于……的」，与 adapt 同出拉丁 aptus。

entries.definition: To change something slightly so that it works or fits better, with less emphasis on a new environment.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「调整、调节」，指小幅改动使其更合适，较少强调新环境。

entries.definition: To change something in part, often deliberately and for a stated purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「修改、改动」，常指有意识地部分改变。

entries.definition: To change arrangements so that someone or something can be included or fit.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「容纳、迁就」，指改变安排以容纳某人或某物。

entries.definition: To become used to a new climate or environment, usually of a body.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「适应气候或环境」，通常指身体的变化。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin root for fit and the patterns the verb appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁「合适」词根，以及动词实际出现的结构。

normal.en: aptus is fit: to adapt is to make something fit by altering it.
normal.cn: aptus 是「合适」：adapt 就是通过改动让某物变合适。

normal.en: ad- points the fitting toward a goal, so adaptare is to fit to something.
normal.cn: ad- 把「合身」指向某个目标，所以 adaptare 是「使适合于某物」。

normal.en: A novel adapted into a film is cut again to fit a new medium.
normal.cn: 小说改编成电影，就是重新裁剪以适合新媒介。

normal.en: Adapt to is intransitive: the person changes himself, not the place.
normal.cn: adapt to 是不及物用法：改变的是人自己，而不是地方。

normal.en: In biology, species adapt over generations until they fit a habitat.
normal.cn: 生物学中，物种经过许多世代适应，直到贴合栖息地。

abstract.en: Picture a tailor letting out a seam so the jacket closes comfortably over a broader chest.
abstract.cn: 想象裁缝把接缝放宽，让外套能舒适地合上更宽的胸膛。

abstract.en: The same jacket can be recut for a child, a play or a new climate: the cloth stays, the fit changes.
abstract.cn: 同一件外套可以被改给小孩、改成戏服或改成适应新气候：布料不变，合身方式变了。

abstract.en: Adapting never means abandoning the material; it means cutting it so it works where it is now.
abstract.cn: 适应从不意味着抛弃材料，而是把它裁到如今所处的地方能用。

examples.en: It took him a month to adapt to the night shift.
examples.cn: 他花了一个月才适应夜班。

examples.en: The story was adapted for young readers.
examples.cn: 这个故事被改编给年轻读者。

examples.en: Engineers adapted the old factory into a data centre.
examples.cn: 工程师把旧工厂改造成了数据中心。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿达普特」——阿达把袖子改窄，正好贴合手臂：适应、改编

root: 拉丁语 adaptare（ad-「向」+ aptare「使合适」，aptare 出自 aptus「合身的、合适的」）意为「使适合于」；aptus 更早的来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of adapt all refit something to a body, a medium, a use, a change or a habitat: the fitting is constant, the thing fitted varies.
sensesIntro.cn: adapt 的八个义项都在把某物重新裁合到一副身躯、一种媒介、一种用途、一次变化或一处栖息地：合身这件事不变，被裁的对象在变。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a seam is taken in and let out until the garment fits the body exactly.
core.cn: 核心意象：接缝被收紧又放宽，直到衣服完全贴合身体。

branches.en: PERSON AND PLACE: the verb can fit a group to a new setting, or a person can fit himself to it.
branches.cn: 人与地方线：动词既能让群体适应新环境，也能让人自己适应环境。

branches.en: MEDIUM: a book, play or story is recut to fit film, stage or another form.
branches.cn: 媒介线：书、戏剧或故事被重新裁剪，以适合电影、舞台或其他形式。

branches.en: OBJECT AND PURPOSE: a barn becomes a workshop, and a text is trimmed for beginners.
branches.cn: 物体与用途线：谷仓变成工坊，文本被修剪到适合初学者。

branches.en: CHANGING CONDITIONS: demand shifts and storms force plans and methods to be altered.
branches.cn: 条件变化线：需求转移与暴风雨迫使计划和方法被改动。

branches.en: EVOLUTION: generation after generation, a species is refitted to its habitat.
branches.cn: 进化线：一代又一代，物种被重新裁合到它的栖息地。

intro.en: Adapt is the Latin prefix ad- plus a Latin verb for fitting; the same aptus root also gives apt and aptitude.
intro.cn: adapt 是拉丁前缀 ad- 加表示「使合适」的拉丁动词；同一 aptus 词根还给出 apt 与 aptitude。

latinIntro.en: Latin aptus, aptare and adaptare are recorded, so only the older origin of aptus is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 aptus、aptare 与 adaptare 均有记录，只有 aptus 更早的来源属于重构。

items.exampleCN: 它把「合身」的方向指向某个目标。

items.example: It keeps the short form of the root.

definition_en: the process of changing to fit new conditions, or a work or thing that has been changed to suit a new use

senses.title: The process of fitting to new conditions
senses.definition: the gradual process by which a person, group or thing changes in order to fit new conditions
senses.definitionCN: 人、群体或事物为适合新条件而逐渐改变的过程
senses.example: Adaptation to high altitude takes several weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 适应高海拔需要好几个星期。
senses.why: The noun names the whole work of taking in and letting out a seam, not the finished garment.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词命名的是收缝放宽的全部工夫，而不是做好的衣服。

senses.title: A work recast in another medium
senses.definition: a book, play or story that has been changed into a film, opera, game or other form
senses.definitionCN: 被改写为电影、歌剧、游戏或其他形式的书、戏剧或故事
senses.example: The film is a faithful adaptation of a best-selling novel.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影是一部畅销小说的忠实改编。
senses.why: The cloth has been recut for a new body, and the result is a new garment, the adaptation.
senses.whyCN: 布料为新的身躯重新裁剪，成品就是一件新衣服，也就是改编作品。

senses.title: The act of rewriting for another form
senses.definition: the act or work of changing a text or work so that it can appear in a different medium
senses.definitionCN: 把文本或作品改动成另一种媒介呈现的行为或工作
senses.example: The adaptation of the play for radio took two years.
senses.exampleCN: 把这部戏剧改编成广播剧花了两年。
senses.why: Here the focus is on the cutting and sewing itself, not on the finished piece.
senses.whyCN: 这里聚焦于裁剪缝合的动作本身，而不是成品。

senses.title: A bodily adjustment to environment
senses.definition: in biology, a change in the body or its behaviour that helps it survive in a particular environment
senses.definitionCN: 生物学中指身体或其行为的变化，帮助其在特定环境中生存
senses.example: Sweating is a useful adaptation to a hot climate.
senses.exampleCN: 出汗是对炎热气候的一种有用适应。
senses.why: The body refits itself to the weather, as a coat is taken in for a warmer season.
senses.whyCN: 身体为天气重新裁剪自己，就像外套为更暖的季节被收窄。

senses.title: An evolved feature of a species
senses.titleCN: 进化适应：演化出的特征
senses.definition: a feature developed over generations that makes a species better suited to its habitat
senses.definitionCN: 经过许多世代形成、使物种更适应栖息地的特征
senses.example: Wings are an adaptation for flight in birds.
senses.exampleCN: 翅膀是鸟类为飞行而形成的适应特征。
senses.why: Evolution does the sewing slowly: each generation trims the species closer to its surroundings.
senses.whyCN: 进化把缝纫做得很慢：每一代都把物种裁得更贴近环境。

senses.title: A modified version of something
senses.definition: a changed or shortened version of an object, text or system made to suit a particular use
senses.definitionCN: 为适合特定用途而对物体、文本或系统作出改动或删减后的版本
senses.example: This is a shorter adaptation of the original report.
senses.exampleCN: 这是原报告的一个精简改编版。
senses.why: One garment is remade into another cut, recognisably the same cloth.
senses.whyCN: 一件衣服被改裁成另一种版型，仍能认出是同一块布。

senses.title: The capacity to adjust
senses.definition: the ability of a person or system to adjust successfully to new circumstances
senses.definitionCN: 人或系统成功调整以适应新环境的能力
senses.example: Her quick adaptation to city life surprised her family.
senses.exampleCN: 她迅速适应城市生活，让家人很意外。
senses.why: The noun can name not the act but the power to perform it, like a tailor's skill.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词可以指的不是动作，而是完成动作的能力，就像裁缝的手艺。

senses.title: A device or modification for a new use
senses.titleCN: 适应装置：为特殊需要做的改装
senses.definition: a device or alteration fitted to equipment so that it can be used by a particular person or in a particular way
senses.definitionCN: 为设备加装的装置或改动，使其可供特定人使用或以特定方式使用
senses.example: The car's hand controls are an adaptation for disabled drivers.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆车的手动控制装置是为残障驾驶者做的改装。
senses.why: Fitting becomes a physical part: the seam is replaced by a bracket or a control.
senses.whyCN: 「合身」变成了实物部件：接缝被支架或操纵杆取代。

intro.en: Adaptation is the noun of adapt, built on the Latin root for fit with a Latin noun suffix.
intro.cn: adaptation 是 adapt 的名词形式，由拉丁「合适」词根加拉丁名词后缀构成。

items.en: aptus meant 'fit, suited'; its deeper origin is source uncertain.
items.cn: aptus 意为「合适的、合身的」；更早的来源不确定。

items.en: ad- plus aptare formed adaptare, 'to fit to, adjust to'.
items.cn: ad- 加 aptare 构成 adaptare，义为「使适合于、调整以适应」。

items.en: adaptatio named the act of fitting or adjusting; the earliest records are medieval and later than the verb.
items.cn: adaptatio 指「使合适、调整」的行为；最早记录属中世纪，晚于动词。

items.en: French adaptation carried the noun into English, where it soon covered both bodily and literary fitting.
items.cn: 法语 adaptation 把这个名词带入英语，很快同时涵盖身体与文学的「适应」。

items.en: Biology fixed adaptation as an evolved trait, and film and theatre made it a common word for a recast work.
items.cn: 生物学把 adaptation 固定为演化特征，电影与戏剧则使它成为「改编作品」的常用词。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the whole Latin family for fitting; the near-meaning group gathers words for adjusted versions and processes of change.
note.cn: 形近组收整个拉丁「使合身」词族；近义组收表示调整后的版本与变化过程的词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to fit oneself or something to new conditions.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「适应、改编」，是本词去掉 -ation 后的动词形式。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning able to adjust, often used in biology.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「适应性的」，常用于生物学。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning able to be changed to fit new conditions.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「能适应的、可改编的」。

entries.definition: The noun for a device that connects different fittings, or for a person who rewrites a work.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「适配器；改编者」，指连接不同接口的装置或改写作品的人。

entries.definition: A small change made so that something works better; narrower and less biological than adaptation.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「调整」，指为使某物更好用所作的小改动，范围比 adaptation 窄。

entries.definition: A form of a work or thing that differs from others of the same kind.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「版本」，指同类作品或事物的一种形式。

entries.definition: A change made to something, usually partial and deliberate.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「修改、改动」，通常指有意的部分改变。

entries.definition: The process of becoming used to a new climate, a narrower technical term.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「气候驯化、适应气候」，属更窄的专门术语。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin noun suffix and the fields where adaptation became a technical term.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁名词后缀，以及 adaptation 成为术语的几个领域。

normal.en: -ation turns the verb adapt into the name of the process or its result.
normal.cn: -ation 把动词 adapt 变成过程或结果的名字。

normal.en: A film adaptation is a novel recut for the screen.
normal.cn: film adaptation 就是为银幕重新裁剪的小说。

normal.en: In biology an adaptation is a trait that helps a species survive.
normal.cn: 生物学中 adaptation 是帮助物种生存的特征。

normal.en: Climate adaptation means changing how we build and farm.
normal.cn: climate adaptation 指改变我们建造与耕作的方式。

normal.en: An adaptation can be a physical add-on, such as hand controls in a car.
normal.cn: adaptation 也可以是实物加装，例如汽车的手动控制装置。

abstract.en: Picture a coat taken apart at the seams and sewn into a different shape without losing its cloth.
abstract.cn: 想象一件外套在接缝处被拆开，缝成另一种形状，布料却一点没丢。

abstract.en: The same cloth becomes a stage costume, a shorter report or a car control: the fitting repeats in different materials.
abstract.cn: 同一块布可以变成舞台服装、精简报告或汽车操纵装置：合身在不同材料上重复。

abstract.en: Evolution is a very slow tailor, adjusting one generation at a time.
abstract.cn: 进化是一位极慢的裁缝，一次只调整一代。

examples.en: The adaptation of the novel for television was a great success.
examples.cn: 这部小说改编成电视剧非常成功。

examples.en: Plants show remarkable adaptation to dry conditions.
examples.cn: 植物对干旱条件表现出惊人的适应。

examples.en: The report is a short adaptation of a longer study.
examples.cn: 这份报告是一份较长研究的精简改编版。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿达普泰申」——阿达把旧衣拆了重缝，合身又成了新样子：适应、改编

root: 拉丁语 adaptare（ad-「向」+ aptare「使合适」）意为「使适合于」，加名词后缀 -atio 成 adaptatio「调整、使合适的行为」；aptus「合身的」更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of adaptation follow one refitting: a process, a recast work, the act of recasting, a body's adjustment, an evolved trait, a modified version, the capacity to adjust, and a physical add-on.
sensesIntro.cn: adaptation 的八个义项都围绕同一次「重新裁合」：过程、改编成品、改编行为、身体调整、演化特征、改动后的版本、调整能力，以及实物加装。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a coat is unpicked at the seams and sewn into a shape that fits its new wearer.
core.cn: 核心意象：外套在接缝处被拆开，重新缝成贴合新穿者的形状。

branches.en: PROCESS: the noun names the work of fitting, whether of a person or of a text.
branches.cn: 过程线：这个名词命名「使之合身」的工夫，无论对象是人是文本。

branches.en: RESULT: a film or a shortened report is the recut garment itself.
branches.cn: 结果线：电影或精简报告就是那件被重新裁剪的衣服。

branches.en: BODY: sweating and other responses refit the body to climate.
branches.cn: 身体线：出汗等反应把身体重新裁合到气候。

branches.en: SPECIES: evolution trims a population closer to its habitat over generations.
branches.cn: 物种线：进化经过许多世代把种群裁得更贴近栖息地。

branches.en: CAPACITY AND HARDWARE: the word can name the ability to adjust or a bracket fitted to a machine.
branches.cn: 能力与硬件线：这个词可以指调整的能力，也可以指装在机器上的支架。

intro.en: Adaptation is a Latin verb stem plus the Latin noun suffix -atio; the family also builds English adjectives and agents.
intro.cn: adaptation 是拉丁动词词干加拉丁名词后缀 -atio；这一词族还用英语后缀造出形容词与施动者名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin aptus, adaptare and adaptatio are recorded; the exact first record of adaptatio is medieval and not certain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 aptus、adaptare 与 adaptatio 均有记录；adaptatio 的确切首见属中世纪，具体年代不确定。

items.exampleCN: 它是这一词族有记录的最早一层。

items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供「使合身」的动作。

items.exampleCN: 它是 adaptation 的直接来源。

definition_zh: 加（数学）；添加；补充说；增加数量；把……加起来；增添（风味）；累积（成本）；附加（条件）
definition_en: to put something together with something else so that the amount, number or effect increases
core_image: 往天平一侧再放一块砝码，刻度随之上升
scene: 妈妈往汤锅里又撒了一小把盐，然后尝了尝味道。She added a pinch of salt to the soup and tasted it again.
sceneCN: 这里 add 是「添加」（第 2 个义项：把某物加入另一物）；句意为她往汤里又加了一小撮盐，然后尝了尝。

pos.zh: 及物动词：加；添加；补充说
不及物动词：增添；累积（多用于 add to）

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀 -ition 构成，义为「加法；添加；新增物」
由 addition 加形容词后缀 -al 构成，义为「额外的；附加的」
由本词加名词后缀 -itive 构成，义为「添加剂」
由 add 与 on 复合而成，义为「附加装置；附加项」
由本词加施动后缀 -er 构成，义为「加法器；相加者」

senses.title: To combine numbers in arithmetic
senses.definition: to combine two or more numbers so as to find their total
senses.definitionCN: 把两个或更多数合并起来求出总和
senses.example: Add three and five and you get eight.
senses.exampleCN: 三加五等于八。
senses.why: The scale image is arithmetic at its plainest: weights are piled on one side and the reading rises.
senses.whyCN: 天平意象最朴素的形式就是算术：砝码一块块堆到一侧，读数随之上升。

senses.title: To put something into a mixture
senses.titleCN: 添加：把某物放进另一物
senses.definition: to put a substance, object or ingredient into something else
senses.definitionCN: 把某种物质、物品或配料放进另一物之中
senses.example: She added milk to the coffee.
senses.exampleCN: 她往咖啡里加了牛奶。
senses.why: One more weight is placed on the pan and becomes part of what is already there.
senses.whyCN: 又一块砝码放上托盘，成为已有之物的一部分。

senses.title: To say something more
senses.definition: to say something further after what has already been said, often as an afterthought
senses.definitionCN: 在已说的话之后再补充一句，常像事后想起
senses.example: He added that the train might be late.
senses.exampleCN: 他补充说火车可能会晚点。
senses.why: Words are treated as weights: one more remark is dropped onto the scale of the conversation.
senses.whyCN: 话语被当作砝码：又一句话被放到对话的天平上。

senses.title: To increase an amount or number
senses.definition: to make a quantity, number or total larger by joining something to it
senses.definitionCN: 通过把某物并入，使数量、数目或总数变大
senses.example: The new wing adds ten rooms to the hotel.
senses.exampleCN: 新侧楼给旅馆增加了十个房间。
senses.why: The pan goes down as more weight arrives; the total is now larger than before.
senses.whyCN: 砝码增加，托盘下沉；总数因此比先前更大。

senses.title: To total a set of figures
senses.definition: in the phrase add up, to put several figures together and find their total
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 add up，表示把若干数字合起来求总数
senses.example: Add up the receipts before you leave the shop.
senses.exampleCN: 离开商店前把收据上的金额加起来。
senses.why: All the separate weights are gathered onto one pan to read a single total.
senses.whyCN: 所有分散的砝码被收到同一托盘上，读出一个总数。

senses.title: To give an extra quality
senses.definition: in the phrase add to, to give something an extra quality, flavour or appearance
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 add to，表示给某物增添额外的性质、风味或外观
senses.example: A little lemon adds freshness to the salad.
senses.exampleCN: 一点柠檬给沙拉增添了清新。
senses.why: The added weight is not quantity but quality: a new note appears in the mixture.
senses.whyCN: 加上的不是数量而是性质：混合物里出现了一个新的调子。

senses.title: To increase a cost or burden
senses.definition: to make a cost, problem or burden greater, especially when it mounts up
senses.definitionCN: 使成本、问题或负担变得更重，尤指逐渐累加
senses.example: The repairs added to the final bill.
senses.exampleCN: 维修费使最终账单更高了。
senses.why: Weights accumulate on the debt side, and the scale keeps tipping.
senses.whyCN: 砝码在债务一侧累积，天平持续倾斜。

senses.title: To attach a condition or clause
senses.definition: to attach an extra condition, clause or remark to an agreement or statement
senses.definitionCN: 在协议或声明上附加额外的条件、条款或说明
senses.example: They added a clause to the contract about late payment.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在合同里加了一条关于逾期付款的条款。
senses.why: A written weight is fastened to the document so that it carries more force.
senses.whyCN: 一块书写好的砝码被系到文件上，使它带上更多分量。

intro.en: Add comes straight from a Latin compound of ad- and dare 'to give', so its oldest picture is giving something to something else.
intro.cn: add 直接来自 ad- 与 dare「给」构成的拉丁复合词，最早的意象是「把某物给到另一物上」。

items.en: *deh- is generally reconstructed as 'to give'; the deeper origin of the root is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧语 *deh- 表示「给」；这一词根更早的来源不确定。

items.en: dare meant 'to give, put, offer', and it is one of the most productive verbs in Latin.
items.cn: dare 意为「给、放置、提供」，是拉丁语中构词能力最强的动词之一。

items.en: ad- 'to' plus dare 'give' formed addere, 'to give to, put to, add'. The second element is generally taken to be dare, though other explanations have been proposed.
items.cn: ad-「向」加 dare「给」构成 addere，义为「给到、放到、加上」。第二成分一般认为就是 dare，但也有其他解释。

items.en: English borrowed the verb from Latin in the fourteenth century; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪从拉丁语借入这个动词；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The arithmetic sense came first, then the everyday senses of putting in, saying more, and attaching a clause.
items.cn: 算术义先出现，随后发展出「放入、补充说、附加条款」等日常义项。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on Latin addere; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of increasing, joining and attaching.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁 addere 构成的词；近义组收表示增加、加入与附加的动词。

entries.definition: The noun for adding or for something added, from Latin additio.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「加法；添加；新增物」，来自拉丁 additio。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning extra or further, formed from addition with -al.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「额外的、附加的」，由 addition 加 -al 构成。

entries.definition: A noun or adjective for a substance added to improve or preserve something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或形容词，义为「添加剂」，指为改良或保鲜而加入的物质。

entries.definition: Something added at the end of a book or document, from the Latin gerundive of addere.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「附录、补遗」，来自 addere 的拉丁动形词，与 add 同根。

entries.definition: To become or make larger in amount; broader than add and needs no second object.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「增加、增长」，范围比 add 宽，且不必有第二个对象。

entries.definition: To attach something at the end, especially to a document.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「附加、增补」，尤其指加在文件末尾，语气正式。

entries.definition: To fasten or join one thing to another, with the idea of physical connection.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「附上、系上」，强调物理连接。

entries.definition: To add numbers and state the total, close to the total sense of add up.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「求和、总结」，接近 add up 的合计义。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin compound dare and the fixed phrases the verb appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁复合词 dare，以及动词实际出现的固定短语。

normal.en: dare is to give: addere is to give something to what is already there.
normal.cn: dare 是「给」：addere 就是把某物给到已有之物上。

normal.en: The same dare also gives data, the things given.
normal.cn: 同一个 dare 还给出 data，也就是「被给出的东西」。

normal.en: Add up gathers figures onto one total, like weights onto one pan.
normal.cn: add up 把数字收到一个总数上，就像砝码收到一个托盘上。

normal.en: Add to adds quality rather than quantity, as lemon does to salad.
normal.cn: add to 加的是性质而不是数量，就像柠檬加到沙拉里。

normal.en: Add insult to injury is the phrase where one more weight makes the load unbearable.
normal.cn: add insult to injury 这个短语里，又一块砝码让负担变得难以承受。

abstract.en: Picture a single weight placed on a scale: the needle moves and the new total is read.
abstract.cn: 想象一块砝码放上天平：指针一动，新的总数就被读出。

abstract.en: The same weight can be salt, a sentence, a room or a clause: in each case it is joined to what exists.
abstract.cn: 同一块砝码可以是盐、一句话、一个房间或一条条款：每一种都是被并入已有之物。

abstract.en: Weights can also pile up on the cost side until the scale tips further than anyone wanted.
abstract.cn: 砝码也可能堆在成本一侧，直到天平倾斜得超出任何人的预期。

examples.en: Add a little sugar to the tea and stir it.
examples.cn: 往茶里加一点糖，然后搅一搅。

examples.en: These figures add up to a much larger sum than we expected.
examples.cn: 这些数字加起来比我们预想的数额大得多。

examples.en: The delay added to our costs.
examples.cn: 这次延误增加了我们的成本。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿德」——阿德往锅里再加一勺，刻度又升一格：添加、增加

root: 拉丁语 addere 由 ad-「向」与 dare「给」构成，义为「给到、放到、加上」；第二成分一般认为来自 dare，另有解释并存。dare 更早可上溯到印欧词根 *deh-「给」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of add all place one more weight on the pan: arithmetic, an ingredient, an extra remark, a larger amount, a total, an added quality, a mounting cost, and an attached clause.
sensesIntro.cn: add 的八个义项都是往托盘上再放一块砝码：算术、配料、补充的话、更大的数量、合计、增添的性质、累积的成本，以及附加的条款。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one more weight is placed on the pan and the needle rises.
core.cn: 核心意象：托盘上再放一块砝码，指针随之上升。

branches.en: NUMBER: figures are gathered and read as one total.
branches.cn: 数字线：数字被收拢，读成一个总数。

branches.en: MATTER: an ingredient or a room is put in, and the whole becomes larger.
branches.cn: 物质线：配料或房间被放入，整体因此变大。

branches.en: WORDS: a remark or a clause is given extra weight on the record.
branches.cn: 话语线：一句话或一条条款在记录上获得额外分量。

branches.en: QUALITY: the addition changes flavour or appearance rather than size.
branches.cn: 性质线：所加之物改变的是风味或外观，而不是大小。

branches.en: BURDEN: weights pile up on the cost side and make the load heavier.
branches.cn: 负担线：砝码堆在成本一侧，使负担更重。

intro.cn: add 由一个拉丁前缀加表示「给」的拉丁动词构成；词族再由拉丁名词与英语后缀扩展。

definition_zh: 吸毒成瘾者；对某活动上瘾的人；入迷者；酒瘾者；网络成瘾者；赌博成瘾者；有瘾的人；医学上的依赖者
definition_en: a person who cannot stop using a substance or doing an activity, or who is devoted to it almost completely
core_image: 一个人被一条看不见的绳子系在某样东西上，越挣扎系得越紧
scene: 他每天醒来第一件事就是找酒瓶，家人劝了多次也没有用。He had become a heavy drinker, an addict who could not face a morning without alcohol.
sceneCN: 这里 addict 是「酒瘾者」（第 4 个义项：对酒精成瘾的人）；句意为他已经成了重度饮酒者，一个早上离不开酒的瘾者。

pos.zh: 名词：成瘾者；入迷的人；有瘾的人
动词：使上瘾；使沉溺（多用于 addict oneself to）

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀 -ion 构成，义为「成瘾；沉溺」
由本词加形容词后缀 -ed 构成，义为「上瘾的；沉迷的」
由本词加形容词后缀 -ive 构成，义为「使人上瘾的」
由 addictive 加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「成瘾性」

senses.title: A person dependent on drugs
senses.definition: a person who is physically or psychologically dependent on an illegal or controlled drug
senses.definitionCN: 对非法或受管制药物产生生理或心理依赖的人
senses.example: The clinic offers treatment for young drug addicts.
senses.exampleCN: 这家诊所收治年轻的吸毒成瘾者。
senses.why: The core image is a rope: the drug holds the person and the person keeps returning to it.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一根绳子：药物拴住了人，人也不断回到它那里。

senses.title: A person hooked on an activity
senses.definition: a person who cannot stop doing a particular activity, such as shopping, gaming or exercise
senses.definitionCN: 无法停止某项活动的人，如购物、游戏或运动
senses.example: He is a gym addict who trains twice a day.
senses.exampleCN: 他是个健身成瘾者，一天训练两次。
senses.why: The rope need not be a substance: any repeated act can fasten itself to a life.
senses.whyCN: 绳子不一定是物质：任何重复的行为都能把自己系到一个人的生活上。

senses.title: An enthusiastic devotee
senses.definition: a person who is very enthusiastic about something and spends much time on it, without a medical sense
senses.definitionCN: 对某事物非常热情、投入大量时间的人，不含医学上的成瘾义
senses.example: She is a film addict who sees every new release.
senses.exampleCN: 她是个电影迷，每部新片都看。
senses.why: The same devotion appears here as pleasure rather than compulsion.
senses.whyCN: 同样的投入在这里显现为乐趣，而不是强迫。

senses.title: A person dependent on alcohol
senses.definition: a person who is dependent on alcohol and cannot control drinking
senses.definitionCN: 依赖酒精、无法控制饮酒的人
senses.example: The programme helps alcohol addicts rebuild their lives.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目帮助酒瘾者重建生活。
senses.why: Alcohol is one more rope, and the image of the tied person stays the same.
senses.whyCN: 酒精是又一根绳子，被系住的人的意象保持不变。

senses.title: A person addicted to the internet
senses.definition: a person whose use of the internet or screens has become compulsive and harmful
senses.definitionCN: 上网或使用屏幕已成强迫行为并造成损害的人
senses.example: Many parents worry that their child has become an internet addict.
senses.exampleCN: 许多父母担心孩子已经成了网络成瘾者。
senses.why: A new medium provides a new rope, but the knot is the same old one.
senses.whyCN: 新的媒介提供新的绳子，打的结却是同一种旧结。

senses.title: A compulsive gambler
senses.definition: a person who cannot stop gambling even when it ruins their money and relationships
senses.definitionCN: 即使赌博毁掉钱财与关系也无法停止的人
senses.example: The support group was founded by a recovered gambling addict.
senses.exampleCN: 这个互助小组由一位康复的赌博成瘾者创立。
senses.why: Chance itself becomes the rope, pulling the person back to the table.
senses.whyCN: 偶然性本身成了绳子，把人一次次拉回赌桌。

senses.title: A generic label for a person with a compulsion
senses.definition: a general noun for anyone whose dependence on something dominates their daily life, with the object left unstated
senses.definitionCN: 泛指任何对某物的依赖支配了日常生活的人，具体对象不点明
senses.example: The shelter takes in addicts of every kind, not only drug users.
senses.exampleCN: 这家收容所接收各种有瘾的人，不只是吸毒者。
senses.why: With no object named, the word keeps only the bare image of a person tied fast.
senses.whyCN: 不点明对象时，这个词只剩「人被紧紧系住」这一赤裸意象。

senses.title: A patient with a diagnosed dependency
senses.definition: in medical and clinical usage, a patient formally diagnosed with a substance or behavioural dependency
senses.definitionCN: 在医学与临床语境中，被正式诊断为物质依赖或行为依赖的患者
senses.example: The ward admits addicts for supervised withdrawal.
senses.exampleCN: 这个病房收治成瘾者进行监督下戒断。
senses.why: The rope becomes a clinical category, measured and treated rather than judged.
senses.whyCN: 绳子在这里成为临床类别，被测量与治疗，而不是被评判。

intro.en: Addict goes back to a Latin verb for assigning a person to someone, and that legal sense of being handed over survives under the modern medical one.
intro.cn: addict 可上溯到拉丁语中表示「把人判归某人」的动词，这种「被交付」的法律意味残留在现代医学义之下。

items.en: dicere meant 'to say, declare, proclaim', and it is the source of many English words in dict-.
items.cn: dicere 意为「说、宣告、宣布」，是英语中许多 dict- 词的来源。

items.en: ad- 'to' plus dicere 'declare' formed addicere, 'to assign, award, devote, surrender'.
items.cn: ad-「向」加 dicere「宣告」构成 addicere，义为「判归、授予、献身、交出」。

items.en: The participle addictus meant 'assigned, devoted, bound over', often of a person given over to another or to a habit.
items.cn: 分词 addictus 意为「被判归的、献身的、交付的」，常指被交给他人或某种习性的人。

items.en: English first used the word for a person devoted to something; the modern drug sense is much later, from the twentieth century.
items.cn: 英语最初用它指「献身于某事物的人」；现代「吸毒成瘾者」义要晚得多，属二十世纪。

items.en: Medicine turned the old legal bond into a diagnosis, and everyday speech extended addict to screens, gambling, gyms and films.
items.cn: 医学把古老的法律束缚变成诊断，日常语言则把 addict 扩展到屏幕、赌博、健身与电影。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the Latin family of addictus; the near-meaning group gathers words for dependent users and intense enthusiasts.
note.cn: 形近组收 addictus 的拉丁词族；近义组收表示依赖者与极度爱好者的一族词。

entries.definition: The noun for the condition of being dependent on a substance or activity.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「成瘾、沉溺」，指对某物质或活动的依赖状态。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning dependent on or devoted to something.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「上瘾的、沉迷的」，由本词加 -ed 构成。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning likely to make someone dependent.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「使人上瘾的」，由本词加 -ive 构成。

entries.definition: A verb meaning to say words for someone to write, from the same Latin dicere.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「口述、命令」，与 addict 同出拉丁 dicere「说」，但前缀不同。

entries.definition: A neutral word for a person who uses a drug, often preferred in official contexts.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「使用者」，在中立或官方语境中常用来指用药者，语气比 addict 温和。

entries.definition: A person who uses a substance harmfully, with the focus on the misuse rather than the dependence.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「滥用者」，侧重有害使用而非依赖。

entries.definition: A person with strong interest in an activity, without any idea of compulsion.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「爱好者、热情者」，不含强迫的意味。

entries.definition: A person who is very devoted to a person, cause or activity.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「献身者、狂热爱好者」，强调投入与忠诚。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin verb for assigning a person and the modern collocations of the noun.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁「判归某人」动词，以及这个名词的现代搭配。

normal.en: addicere is to hand a person over: an addict is someone handed over to a habit.
normal.cn: addicere 是「把人交付出去」：addict 就是被交给某种习性的人。

normal.en: dicere is to declare, which is why dictate and addict share a root.
normal.cn: dicere 是「宣告」，所以 dictate 与 addict 共有一个词根。

normal.en: The noun takes the stress on the first syllable; the verb takes it on the second.
normal.cn: 名词重音在第一音节，动词重音在第二音节。

normal.en: Be addicted to is the common adjectival pattern for dependence.
normal.cn: be addicted to 是表示依赖的常见形容词结构。

normal.en: In modern use the word stretches from drugs to screens, gambling and films.
normal.cn: 现代用法把这个词从毒品扩展到屏幕、赌博与电影。

abstract.en: Picture a thin rope tied around a person's wrist and fastened to a bottle, a screen or a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一根细绳系在人的手腕上，另一头系在酒瓶、屏幕或赌桌上。

abstract.en: The rope does not care what it is tied to; only the pulling is the same in every case.
abstract.cn: 绳子不在乎系在什么上；每一种情形里相同的只是那股拉力。

abstract.en: Sometimes the rope is a pleasure rather than a prison, which is why a film addict is not a patient.
abstract.cn: 有时绳子是乐趣而非牢笼，所以电影迷并不算病人。

examples.en: The centre provides clean needles for drug addicts.
examples.cn: 该中心为吸毒成瘾者提供清洁针具。

examples.en: He described himself as a recovering gambling addict.
examples.cn: 他称自己是一名正在康复的赌博成瘾者。

examples.en: She was addicted to her phone and checked it every minute.
examples.cn: 她对手机上瘾，每分钟都要看一眼。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿迪克特」——阿迪被一根绳子系在瓶子上，怎么挣也挣不开：成瘾者

root: 拉丁语 addicere（ad-「向」+ dicere「宣告」）意为「判归、交付、献身」，分词 addictus 指被交付给他人或某种习性的人；现代「成瘾者」义由这一「被束缚」的意象发展而来。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of addict all describe a person tied to something: a drug, an activity, a hobby, alcohol, the internet, gambling, any compulsion at all, or a clinical diagnosis.
sensesIntro.cn: addict 的八个义项都在描述一个被系住的人：毒品、活动、爱好、酒精、网络、赌博、任何强迫，或一项临床诊断。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person with a thin rope tied to the wrist, the other end fastened to something they cannot leave.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人手腕上系着细绳，另一端系在他离不开的东西上。

branches.en: SUBSTANCES: drugs and alcohol are the oldest ropes, tied to the body itself.
branches.cn: 物质线：毒品与酒精是最古老的绳子，直接系在身体上。

branches.en: BEHAVIOURS: gyms, screens and gambling tables provide ropes made of repeated acts.
branches.cn: 行为线：健身、屏幕与赌桌提供由重复行为编成的绳子。

branches.en: ENTHUSIASM: the same devotion appears without the element of compulsion.
branches.cn: 热情线：同样的投入在这里不含强迫的成分。

branches.en: GENERIC: with no object named, only the bare image of a tied person remains.
branches.cn: 泛称线：不点明对象时，只剩「被系住的人」这一赤裸意象。

branches.en: CLINIC: the rope becomes a diagnosis, measured and treated by professionals.
branches.cn: 临床线：绳子变成诊断，由专业人员测量与治疗。
