definition_zh: 加法；添加；新增物；附加建筑；附加条款；in addition 另外；in addition to 除……之外；补充人员
definition_en: the act of adding something, or the thing that is added to what already exists
core_image: 在已有的房子上再接出一间侧屋，整座建筑随之变大
scene: 老屋后面又接出了一间小屋，成了孩子写作业的书房。A small addition at the back of the house became the child's study.
sceneCN: 这里 addition 是「附加建筑」（第 4 个义项：在房屋上加建的部分）；句意为屋后加建的小屋成了孩子的书房。

pos.zh: 名词：加法；添加；新增物；附加建筑

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉名词后缀 -ition 回到动词，义为「加；添加」
由本词加形容词后缀 -al 构成，义为「额外的；附加的」
由 additional 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「此外；另外」
由 add 加名词后缀 -itive 构成，义为「添加剂」
由拉丁动形词 addendum 借入，义为「附录；补遗」

senses.title: The arithmetic operation of adding
senses.definition: the mathematical operation of combining two or more numbers into a single total
senses.definitionCN: 把两个或更多数合并成一个总数的数学运算
senses.example: Children usually learn addition before multiplication.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子通常先学加法，再学乘法。
senses.why: The image is a new room joined to a house: here numbers are the rooms and the total is the house.
senses.whyCN: 意象是给房子接上新房间：这里数字是房间，总数是整座房子。

senses.title: The act of adding something
senses.definition: the act or process of putting something into or onto something else
senses.definitionCN: 把某物放进或加到另一物之上的行为或过程
senses.example: The addition of a new wing changed the whole school.
senses.exampleCN: 新侧楼的加建改变了整所学校。
senses.why: Here the noun names the building work rather than the finished room.
senses.whyCN: 这里名词指的是建造这件事，而不是建好的房间。

senses.title: Something newly added
senses.definition: a person or thing that has recently been added to a group, collection or system
senses.definitionCN: 最近被加入某个群体、收藏或系统的人或物
senses.example: The latest addition to the team is a young coach.
senses.exampleCN: 球队最新的成员是一位年轻教练。
senses.why: The new room is now part of the house and can be pointed at.
senses.whyCN: 新房间现在已是房子的一部分，可以被指认出来。

senses.title: An extension built onto a house
senses.titleCN: 附加建筑：房屋的加建部分
senses.definition: a part built onto an existing building to make it larger
senses.definitionCN: 为扩大现有建筑而在其上加建的部分
senses.example: They built a two-room addition at the back of the cottage.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在小屋后面加建了两个房间。
senses.why: This is the core image made literal: a new piece is joined to the old structure.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心意象的字面实现：新部件被接到旧结构上。

senses.title: An extra clause in a document
senses.definition: an extra clause or item attached to a contract, law or official document
senses.definitionCN: 附加在合同、法律或正式文件上的额外条款或项目
senses.example: An addition to the contract was signed a month later.
senses.exampleCN: 一个月后签署了合同的一份补充条款。
senses.why: Paper can grow a new room too: the clause is built onto the original text.
senses.whyCN: 纸张也能长出新房间：条款被加建到原文之上。

senses.title: As an extra point, in addition
senses.definition: in the phrase in addition, used to introduce a further point or item
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 in addition，引出又一个要点或项目
senses.example: In addition, the museum is free on Sunday mornings.
senses.exampleCN: 另外，博物馆周日上午免费。
senses.why: The speaker adds one more room to the argument before closing it.
senses.whyCN: 说话人在收尾前又给论证接上一个房间。

senses.title: Besides, in addition to
senses.definition: in the phrase in addition to, meaning besides or as well as
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 in addition to，表示「除……之外还、以及」
senses.example: In addition to English, she speaks two other languages.
senses.exampleCN: 除了英语，她还会说另外两种语言。
senses.why: An existing room is acknowledged, and another room is joined beside it.
senses.whyCN: 先承认已有的房间，再在旁边接上另一间。

senses.title: A person added to a group
senses.definition: a new member or employee recently added to a team, family or staff
senses.definitionCN: 最近加入团队、家庭或员工队伍的新成员
senses.example: The new addition to the staff starts work on Monday.
senses.exampleCN: 新加入的员工周一开始上班。
senses.why: A person is treated as a new room in the household or the office.
senses.whyCN: 人被当作家庭或办公室里新添的一间房。

intro.en: Addition is the Latin noun of addere, the same compound of ad- and dare that gives the verb add.
intro.cn: addition 是拉丁语 addere 的名词形式，与动词 add 同出 ad- 加 dare 的复合结构。

items.en: dare meant 'to give, put'; the deeper Indo-European root is generally reconstructed as 'to give'.
items.cn: dare 意为「给、放置」；更早的印欧词根一般认为表示「给」。

items.en: ad- 'to' plus dare formed addere, 'to give to, put to, add'.
items.cn: ad-「向」加 dare 构成 addere，义为「给到、放到、加上」。

items.en: additio named the act of adding or the thing added; the noun is recorded in classical Latin.
items.cn: additio 指「添加的行为」或「所加之物」；这一名词在古典拉丁语中已有记录。

items.en: French addition carried the word into English, where it kept both the arithmetic and the building senses.
items.cn: 法语 addition 把这个词带入英语，算术义与建筑义都保留下来。

items.en: The fixed phrases in addition and in addition to made the noun a common linking word in writing.
items.cn: 固定短语 in addition 与 in addition to 使这个名词成为书面语中常见的连接词。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the Latin adding family; the near-meaning group gathers words for things joined on, added on or supplied.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁「添加」词族；近义组收表示接上、附加与补充的词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to put something with something else so that the total grows.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「加、添加」，是把某物并入使总数变大。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning extra or further, formed with -al.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「额外的、附加的」，由本词加 -al 构成。

entries.definition: A substance added in small amounts to improve or preserve something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「添加剂」，指少量加入以改良或保鲜的物质。

entries.definition: An item added at the end of a book or document, from Latin addere.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「附录、补遗」，指书或文件末尾增补的内容，来自拉丁 addere。

entries.definition: Something added to complete or improve what is already there.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「补充物」，指为补全或改善已有之物而添加的东西。

entries.definition: An added part that makes something longer or larger, especially a building.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「扩建部分、延伸」，尤指建筑的加建。

entries.definition: An additional item for which more is charged, or simply something more.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或形容词，义为「额外的东西」，常指需另付费的附加项。

entries.definition: The act of putting something inside a text or object.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「插入」，指把某物放进文本或物体内部。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin noun additio and the fixed phrases built from it.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁名词 additio，以及由它构成的固定短语。

normal.en: additio is the noun of addere: the act of giving something to what is there.
normal.cn: additio 是 addere 的名词：把某物给到已有之物的行为。

normal.en: Addition covers both the sum on paper and the new room on the house.
normal.cn: addition 既指纸上的总和，也指房子上新加的房间。

normal.en: In addition introduces another point, like another room in the argument.
normal.cn: in addition 引出又一个要点，像论证里再添一间房。

normal.en: In addition to acknowledges the old and joins the new beside it.
normal.cn: in addition to 先承认旧的，再把新的接在旁边。

normal.en: A new addition to the staff is a person treated as a new room.
normal.cn: 「a new addition to the staff」就是把新员工当作新添的一间房。

abstract.en: Picture a cottage with a fresh extension on its side: the old walls remain, the outline grows.
abstract.cn: 想象一座小屋侧面新接出一间：旧墙还在，轮廓变大了。

abstract.en: The same extension can be a clause, a member or a sum: in every case something is joined on.
abstract.cn: 同一间加建可以是条款、成员或总和：每一种都是接上了一部分。

abstract.en: The phrase in addition works like a doorway into the next room of the text.
abstract.cn: 短语 in addition 就像通往文本下一间房的门。

examples.en: In addition to French, he studies German at school.
examples.cn: 除了法语，他在学校还学德语。

examples.en: The addition of a small kitchen made the flat far more usable.
examples.cn: 加建一个小厨房让这套公寓好用得多。

examples.en: She is the newest addition to our research group.
examples.cn: 她是我们研究组最新加入的成员。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿迪申」——阿迪给老房子接上一间新房，总数又多一块：添加、加法

root: 拉丁语 additio 是 addere（ad-「向」+ dare「给」，义为「给到、加上」）的名词形式，指「添加的行为或所加之物」；法语 addition 将其带入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of addition all add a room to a house: the arithmetic sum, the act, the new thing, the extension, the extra clause, the phrase in addition, the phrase in addition to, and a new person on staff.
sensesIntro.cn: addition 的八个义项都是给房子添一间房：算术总和、添加行为、新增之物、加建部分、附加条款、in addition、in addition to，以及新来的员工。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a new room is joined onto an existing house and the whole outline grows.
core.cn: 核心意象：新房间接到已有房屋上，整体轮廓随之扩大。

branches.en: NUMBER: numbers are joined and read as a single sum.
branches.cn: 数字线：数字被接合，读成一个和。

branches.en: ACT AND OBJECT: the noun names either the adding or the thing added.
branches.cn: 行为与对象线：这个名词既可指添加行为，也可指所加之物。

branches.en: BUILDING: the core image becomes a literal extension on a house.
branches.cn: 建筑线：核心意象成为房屋上字面意义的加建。

branches.en: DOCUMENT: a clause is attached to a contract as a new room on paper.
branches.cn: 文件线：条款作为纸面上的新房间被接到合同上。

branches.en: LINKING AND PEOPLE: the phrases add a point, and a person is a new room in the staff.
branches.cn: 连接与人物线：短语添加一个要点，而人则是员工队伍里新添的一间房。

intro.en: Addition is a Latin verb stem plus -itio; the same dare root also builds add, additional and additive.
intro.cn: addition 是拉丁动词词干加 -itio；同一 dare 词根还造出 add、additional 与 additive。

latinIntro.en: Latin dare, addere and additio are recorded; only the older Indo-European root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dare、addere 与 additio 均有记录；只有更早的印欧词根属于重构。

items.example: It turns dare into addere.
items.exampleCN: 它把 dare 变成 addere。

items.example: The giving verb is the heart of the family.
items.exampleCN: 这个「给」动词是词族的核心。

items.example: It supplies the verb add.
items.exampleCN: 它提供动词 add。

items.example: It is the direct source of addition.
items.exampleCN: 它是 addition 的直接来源。

items.example: It forms addition.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 addition。

items.example: It forms additional.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 additional。

items.example: It forms additionally.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 additionally。

items.meaning: that which is to be added
items.example: English borrowed it as a noun for an appendix.
items.exampleCN: 英语把它借作「附录」的名词。

latinEntries.meaning: that which is to be added

definition_zh: 地址；演说；致辞（向……讲话）；称呼；处理（问题）；写地址；演说文体；网络地址
definition_en: the details of where someone lives or where something is, or a formal speech; as a verb, to speak to, to name, or to deal with something
core_image: 把一封信的方向摆正，让它直直地指向收信人
scene: 开学典礼开始前，主持人请校长上台对全校师生讲话。The principal will address the whole school at the opening ceremony.
sceneCN: 这里 address 是「向……讲话、致辞」（第 3 个义项：正式对众人发言）；句意为校长将在开学典礼上向全校讲话。

pos.zh: 名词：地址；演说；演说文体
动词：向……讲话；称呼；处理；写地址

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀 -ee 构成，义为「收件人；被称呼者」
由本词加形容词后缀 -able 构成，义为「可处理的；可寻址的」
由本词加施动后缀 -er 构成，义为「发件人；说话者」
由本词加名词后缀 -ing 构成，义为「称呼方式；寻址」

senses.title: The place where someone lives
senses.definition: the details of a place, such as a street and number, where a person lives or a building stands
senses.definitionCN: 某人居住或某建筑所在之处的详细信息，如街道与门牌
senses.example: Please write your home address on the form.
senses.exampleCN: 请在表格上写下你的家庭住址。
senses.why: The image points the letter straight at a door; the address is that direction written down.
senses.whyCN: 意象是把信直直指向一扇门；地址就是写下来的那个方向。

senses.title: A formal speech to an audience
senses.titleCN: 演说：面向听众的正式讲话
senses.definition: a formal speech delivered to an audience on an important occasion
senses.definitionCN: 在重要场合向听众发表的正式讲话
senses.example: The president gave a short address to the nation.
senses.exampleCN: 总统向全国发表了简短演说。
senses.why: Speech is directed at listeners as a letter is directed at a door.
senses.whyCN: 讲话指向听众，就像信件指向一扇门。

senses.title: To speak formally to a group
senses.definition: to speak formally to a group of people, especially at an event
senses.definitionCN: 正式地对一群人讲话，尤指在某个活动上
senses.example: The principal will address the whole school at assembly.
senses.exampleCN: 校长将在集会上向全校讲话。
senses.why: The verb turns the straight direction into an act: words are aimed at the group.
senses.whyCN: 动词把「直指」变成动作：话语被对准这一群人。

senses.title: To name someone in speech
senses.titleCN: 称呼：用某个名称叫某人
senses.definition: to speak to or refer to someone using a particular title or name
senses.definitionCN: 用某个头衔或名字来称呼或指称某人
senses.example: You should address the judge as Your Honour.
senses.exampleCN: 你应当称呼法官为「法官阁下」。
senses.why: A name is a direction too: it aims the words at the right person.
senses.whyCN: 名字也是一种方向：它把话语对准正确的人。

senses.title: To deal with a problem
senses.definition: to take action in order to deal with a problem, need or issue
senses.definitionCN: 采取行动以处理问题、需求或议题
senses.example: The city must address the housing shortage.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市必须解决住房短缺问题。
senses.why: The letter is aimed at the problem instead of being left unaddressed.
senses.whyCN: 这封信被指向问题，而不是被搁置不管。

senses.title: To write a destination on mail
senses.titleCN: 写地址：在邮件上写明去向
senses.definition: to write the name and destination on an envelope, parcel or package
senses.definitionCN: 在信封、包裹或邮包上写明姓名与去向
senses.example: She addressed the envelope to her aunt in the countryside.
senses.exampleCN: 她在信封上写下乡下姑妈的地址。
senses.why: This is the core image as a physical act: the hand turns the envelope straight.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心意象的实物动作：手把信封摆正。

senses.title: The style of a formal speech
senses.titleCN: 演说文体：正式讲话的风格
senses.definition: the manner or style in which a formal public speech is composed and delivered
senses.definitionCN: 正式公开讲话的撰写与表达风格
senses.example: The address moved easily between praise and warning.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇演说在赞扬与警告之间转换自如。
senses.why: The direction becomes a manner: how the words are aimed, not only at whom.
senses.whyCN: 方向变成了方式：话语如何被对准，而不只是对准谁。

senses.title: A location on a network
senses.titleCN: 网络地址：网络上的位置
senses.definition: a string of characters that identifies where data can be found or sent on a network
senses.definitionCN: 在网络上标明数据所在或所去位置的一串字符
senses.example: The server's address changed after the upgrade.
senses.exampleCN: 升级之后服务器的地址变了。
senses.why: A digital door has a direction too, and the word keeps its pointing image.
senses.whyCN: 数字世界的一扇门也有方向，这个词保留了「指向」的意象。

intro.en: Address goes back to a Latin phrase meaning to make straight, and its first English senses were about directing and preparing rather than a postal address.
intro.cn: address 可上溯到意为「使变直」的拉丁短语，它最早的英语义项与「指向、准备」有关，而不是邮政地址。

items.en: dirigere meant 'to set straight, guide, direct', from regere 'to rule, keep straight'.
items.cn: dirigere 意为「使直、引导、指挥」，来自 regere「统治、使保持直」。

items.en: The participle directus meant 'straight, direct', and it underlies English direct and direction.
items.cn: 分词 directus 意为「直的、直接的」，是英语 direct 与 direction 的基础。

items.en: ad- plus directiare formed addirectiare, 'to make straight toward', a late and less common formation.
items.cn: ad- 加 directiare 构成 addirectiare，义为「使朝向、使直指」，属较晚且不常见的构词。

items.en: adresser meant 'to make straight, direct, prepare, equip'; English took the word from French, not directly from Latin.
items.cn: adresser 意为「使直、指向、准备、装备」；英语从法语借入这个词，而非直接来自拉丁语。

items.en: The sense of a written destination and a formal speech both grew from the idea of aiming words or letters at someone.
items.cn: 「写明去向」与「正式讲话」两个义项，都从「把话语或信件对准某人」的想法生长出来。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words on the Latin root for straight; the near-meaning group gathers words for speeches and for dealing with problems.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁「直」词根上的词；近义组收表示演说与处理问题的词。

entries.definition: The person to whom a letter or message is sent, formed with -ee.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「收件人」，由本词加 -ee 构成。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning able to be dealt with or located, used in computing too.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「可处理的、可寻址的」，也用于计算机领域。

entries.definition: An adjective or verb meaning straight, or to aim and guide, from Latin directus.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词或动词，义为「直接的」或「指引」，来自拉丁 directus。

entries.definition: The course in which something moves or is aimed.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「方向、指示」，指某物移动或被对准的路线。

entries.definition: A talk given to an audience; the general word for what address means formally.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「演讲」，是 address 正式义项的一般说法。

entries.definition: A formal talk given to teach or inform, usually to students.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「讲座」，指向学生讲授或说明的正式讲话。

entries.definition: To deal with a problem in an active way, close to address a problem.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「着手处理」，接近 address a problem 的用法。

entries.definition: To manage or deal with a situation, often with the idea of skill.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「应对、处理」，常含技巧意味。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin root for straight and the two families of meaning the word now carries.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁「直」词根，以及这个词如今承担的两族意义。

normal.en: directus is straight: to address is to aim something straight at a person or place.
normal.cn: directus 是「直的」：address 就是把某物直直对准一个人或一个地方。

normal.en: A written address is a direction for a letter.
normal.cn: 写下的 address 就是一封信的方向。

normal.en: To address a meeting is to aim your words at the audience.
normal.cn: address a meeting 就是把话对准听众。

normal.en: To address a problem is to aim action at it instead of leaving it alone.
normal.cn: address a problem 就是把行动对准问题，而不是放着不管。

normal.en: An email address is a digital door with a direction.
normal.cn: email address 是一扇带方向的数字之门。

abstract.en: Picture a hand turning an envelope until its front faces the door it must reach.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手转动信封，直到正面朝向它必须抵达的那扇门。

abstract.en: The same straightening can be done to words, to a title or to a problem.
abstract.cn: 同样的「摆正」可以对信件、对言辞、对头衔或对问题去做。

abstract.en: When a speaker addresses a crowd, the direction is not physical but still exact.
abstract.cn: 当演讲者向人群讲话时，方向不是物理的，却依然精确。

examples.en: Send the letter to the address on the card.
examples.cn: 把信寄到卡片上的地址。

examples.en: The report addresses the causes of the delay.
examples.cn: 这份报告处理了延误的原因。

examples.en: He addressed his teacher as Professor Li.
examples.cn: 他称呼他的老师为李教授。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿德瑞斯」——阿德把信封摆正，直直指向那扇门：地址、致辞

root: 古法语 adresser 意为「使直、指向、准备」，源自晚期拉丁 addirectiare（ad-「向」+ directus「直的」）；directus 出自动词 dirigere「使直、引导」，与 direct、direction 同族。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of address all point something straight at a target: a place, a speech, a group, a name, a problem, an envelope, a style, or a network location.
sensesIntro.cn: address 的八个义项都是把某物直直对准一个目标：地点、演说、人群、名字、问题、信封、文体或网络位置。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an envelope is turned until it points straight at the door it must reach.
core.cn: 核心意象：信封被摆正，直直指向它必须抵达的那扇门。

branches.en: PLACE ON PAPER: a written direction becomes the address of a home or an envelope.
branches.cn: 纸面地点线：写下的方向成为住宅或信封上的地址。

branches.en: SPEECH: words are aimed at an audience, as a noun and as a verb.
branches.cn: 讲话线：话语对准听众，既是名词也是动词。

branches.en: NAMING: a title aims the words at the right person.
branches.cn: 称呼线：头衔把话语对准正确的人。

branches.en: PROBLEM: action is aimed at an issue that must be dealt with.
branches.cn: 问题线：行动被对准必须处理的议题。

branches.en: STYLE AND NETWORK: the word names how words are aimed, and where data is aimed.
branches.cn: 文体与网络线：这个词既指话语如何被对准，也指数据被指向何处。

intro.en: Address is a French reshaping of a late Latin compound built on the root for straight; English added its own suffixes later.
intro.cn: address 是法语对晚期拉丁复合词的重塑，词根意为「直」；英语后来又加上自己的后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin dirigere, directus and addirectiare are recorded, though addirectiare is late and uncommon; its first record is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dirigere、directus 与 addirectiare 均有记录，但 addirectiare 较晚且不常见，确切首见不确定。

items.example: It adds the idea of aiming toward a target.
items.exampleCN: 它加上「朝目标对准」的意思。

items.example: It is the deeper verb behind directus.
items.exampleCN: 它是 directus 背后更深的动词。

items.example: It gives English direct.
items.exampleCN: 它给出英语 direct。

items.example: It is the core of the address family.
items.exampleCN: 它是 address 词族的核心。

items.example: It passed into French as adresser.
items.exampleCN: 它进入法语成为 adresser。

items.example: It is the immediate source of English address.
items.exampleCN: 它是英语 address 的直接来源。

items.example: It forms addressee.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 addressee。

items.example: It forms addressable.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 addressable。

definition_zh: 足够的；充分的（理由）；合格的（能力）；适当的；尚可的；充足供应；合理预先通知；适当救济
definition_en: enough in quantity, or good enough in quality, for a particular purpose or standard
core_image: 一只水杯正好倒到刻度线，不多不少，够用就好
scene: 评委认为这份报告虽然朴素，但作为初稿已经够用。The committee judged the draft adequate for the next stage.
sceneCN: 这里 adequate 是「足够的、够用的」（第 1 个义项：数量或程度满足需要）；句意为委员会认为这份初稿足以进入下一阶段。

pos.zh: 形容词：足够的；充分的；适当的；尚可的

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀 -acy 构成，义为「充足；胜任；适当」
由本词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「充分地；适当地」
由本词加否定前缀 in- 构成，义为「不足的；不合格的」
由 inadequate 加名词后缀 -acy 构成，义为「不足；不胜任」
由本词加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「足够性；适当性」

senses.title: Enough in quantity for a need
senses.definition: having or providing enough of something for a particular need or number of people
senses.definitionCN: 拥有或提供足够的某物，以满足特定需要或人数
senses.example: The village has an adequate supply of clean water.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村子有充足的清洁饮水。
senses.why: The image fills a cup exactly to the mark: no more is needed, but no less works.
senses.whyCN: 意象是把杯子正好倒到刻度线：不必再多，少了却不行。

senses.title: Sufficient to support a claim
senses.titleCN: 充分的：理由或证据成立
senses.definition: enough in quality or strength to support a claim, argument or decision
senses.definitionCN: 在质量或力度上足以支撑一项主张、论证或决定
senses.example: There is adequate evidence to support the charge.
senses.exampleCN: 有充分的证据支持这项指控。
senses.why: The mark on the cup is a standard, and the contents must reach it to count.
senses.whyCN: 杯上的刻度就是标准，内容必须到达那里才算数。

senses.title: Good enough in ability for a task
senses.definition: having enough skill or ability to perform a particular job or role
senses.definitionCN: 具备足够的技能或能力来承担某项工作或角色
senses.example: She is adequate for the demands of the job.
senses.exampleCN: 她足以胜任这份工作的要求。
senses.why: A person is measured against the mark like liquid in a cup.
senses.whyCN: 人被对刻度衡量，就像杯中的液体。

senses.title: Suitable for a particular purpose
senses.definition: suitable or appropriate for a stated purpose, often with for or to
senses.definitionCN: 对特定用途合适或恰当，常与 for 或 to 连用
senses.example: The room is adequate for a small meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 这个房间开小型会议够用了。
senses.why: The cup is judged not in the abstract but against what it must hold.
senses.whyCN: 杯子不是被抽象地评判，而是按它必须装的东西来评判。

senses.title: Acceptable but not excellent
senses.definition: acceptable or passable in quality, though noticeably short of very good
senses.definitionCN: 质量上可以接受、过得去，但明显算不上很好
senses.example: His performance was adequate, though not memorable.
senses.exampleCN: 他的表现尚可，却算不上令人难忘。
senses.why: The liquid reaches the line and stops there: serviceable, unremarkable.
senses.whyCN: 液体刚到刻度线就停住：能用，但不起眼。

senses.title: A sufficient stock kept in reserve
senses.definition: a quantity of goods or supplies kept in reserve that is enough for expected demand
senses.definitionCN: 为应付预期需求而储备的、数量足够的货物或用品
senses.example: The hospital keeps an adequate supply of blood for emergencies.
senses.exampleCN: 医院为急救储备了充足的血液。
senses.why: The cup is a store cupboard filled to the line before the need arrives.
senses.whyCN: 杯子成了需求到来之前就倒到刻度的储备柜。

senses.title: Reasonable advance notice in law
senses.titleCN: 合理预先通知：法律用语
senses.definition: in law, notice given early enough and in enough detail for a person to respond properly
senses.definitionCN: 法律上指时间足够早、内容足够详细，使当事人能适当应对的通知
senses.example: Tenants must receive adequate notice before eviction.
senses.exampleCN: 房东在驱逐房客前必须给予合理的预先通知。
senses.why: Notice is measured like liquid: there is a legal line it must reach.
senses.whyCN: 通知也像液体一样被量度：有一条法律刻度必须达到。

senses.title: An effective legal remedy
senses.titleCN: 适当救济：法律上的有效补救
senses.definition: in law, a remedy that is effective and sufficient to repair the wrong suffered
senses.definitionCN: 法律上指足以弥补所受损害的、有效而充分的补救
senses.example: The court asked whether an adequate remedy existed.
senses.exampleCN: 法院询问是否存在适当的救济。
senses.why: The cup must actually hold what was lost; a remedy that cannot is not adequate.
senses.whyCN: 杯子必须真正装得下所失之物；装不下的救济就不算适当。

intro.en: Adequate comes from a Latin participle meaning made equal to something, which is why it measures fitness against a standard.
intro.cn: adequate 来自意为「使与某物相等」的拉丁分词，因此它总是拿一个标准来衡量是否相称。

items.en: aequus meant 'level, even, equal, fair', and it also gives equity and equable.
items.cn: aequus 意为「平的、均等的、公平的」，也是 equity 与 equable 的来源。

items.en: aequare meant 'to make level or equal', formed on aequus.
items.cn: aequare 意为「使平、使相等」，由 aequus 构成。

items.en: ad- plus aequare formed adaequare, 'to make equal to, bring up to a level'.
items.cn: ad- 加 aequare 构成 adaequare，义为「使与……相等、提到同一水平」。

items.en: The participle adaequatus meant 'made equal to, proportionate', and English took it as adequate in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 分词 adaequatus 意为「与……相等的、相称的」，英语在十七世纪把它借作 adequate。

items.en: The word moved from exact proportion to the practical sense of enough or good enough for a purpose.
items.cn: 这个词从「精确相称」转向实用义，即「对某用途足够或够好」。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the Latin family of aequus; the near-meaning group gathers words for sufficiency and acceptability.
note.cn: 形近组收 aequus 的拉丁词族；近义组收表示足够与可接受的词。

entries.definition: The noun for the state of being enough or suitable.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「充足、适当」，指足够或合适的性质。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning sufficiently or suitably.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「充分地、适当地」。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning not enough or not good enough, with in- added.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不足的、不合格的」，由本词加 in- 构成。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning even or steady, from the same Latin aequus.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「平稳的、均匀的」，与 adequate 同出拉丁 aequus。

entries.definition: Enough for a purpose, often in formal or legal contexts; close to adequate but without the quality sense.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「足够的」，常用于正式或法律语境，比 adequate 少一层质量义。

entries.definition: The plain everyday word for a sufficient amount.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词或副词，是最日常的「足够」说法。

entries.definition: Good enough to be agreed to, though not necessarily excellent.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「可以接受的」，不一定是优秀。

entries.definition: Meeting an expected standard, slightly more positive than adequate.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「令人满意的」，比 adequate 稍积极。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin root for equal and the practical measure of a cup filled to the line.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁「相等」词根，以及「杯子倒到刻度」这一实用尺度。

normal.en: aequus is equal: adequate means brought up to the level required.
normal.cn: aequus 是「相等」：adequate 就是被提到所需水平。

normal.en: adaequare is to make equal to, which is exactly what the cup must do.
normal.cn: adaequare 是「使与……相等」，正是杯子必须做到的事。

normal.en: Adequate supply is stock filled to the line before demand arrives.
normal.cn: adequate supply 是需求到来之前就倒到刻度的储备。

normal.en: In law, adequate notice must reach a legal line of time and detail.
normal.cn: 法律上，adequate notice 必须达到时间与细节的法定刻度。

normal.en: An adequate remedy must actually hold what was lost.
normal.cn: adequate remedy 必须真正装得下所失之物。

abstract.en: Picture a cup filled exactly to the engraved line: the mark is the standard, the liquid is the performance.
abstract.cn: 想象一只杯子正好倒到刻线：刻线是标准，液体是表现。

abstract.en: Every use of adequate compares something to a line, whether water, evidence or notice.
abstract.cn: adequate 的每种用法都拿某物对一条线比较，无论那是水、证据还是通知。

abstract.en: Reaching the line is enough, but it is not the same as overflowing it with excellence.
abstract.cn: 到达刻度就已够用，却不等于用优秀把它倒满溢出。

examples.en: The lighting in the workshop is adequate but not ideal.
examples.cn: 车间的照明够用，但并不理想。

examples.en: We need adequate time to prepare the presentation.
examples.cn: 我们需要足够的时间准备演示。

examples.en: The court found that the remedy was not adequate.
examples.cn: 法院认定这项救济并不适当。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿德夸特」——阿德把杯子正好倒到刻线，够用就行：足够的

root: 拉丁语 adaequatus 是 adaequare（ad-「向」+ aequare「使相等」，aequare 出自 aequus「平的、相等的」）的分词，义为「与……相等的、相称的」；英语在十七世纪借入。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of adequate all measure something against a line: quantity, evidence, ability, purpose, bare acceptability, reserve stock, legal notice, and legal remedy.
sensesIntro.cn: adequate 的八个义项都拿某物对一条刻线量度：数量、证据、能力、用途、勉强够格、储备库存、法律通知与法律救济。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cup filled exactly to the engraved line, no more and no less than the standard.
core.cn: 核心意象：杯子正好倒到刻线，不多不少达到标准。

branches.en: QUANTITY: water and blood are stocked until the line is reached.
branches.cn: 数量线：水与血液被储备到刻度为止。

branches.en: PROOF: evidence must be strong enough to support the claim.
branches.cn: 证据线：证据必须强到足以支撑主张。

branches.en: ABILITY: a person is measured against the demands of a role.
branches.cn: 能力线：人按角色的要求被量度。

branches.en: PURPOSE: suitability is judged by what the thing must hold or do.
branches.cn: 用途线：合适与否按它必须装下或完成的事来评判。

branches.en: STANDARD AND LAW: bare acceptability, notice and remedy each have a line to reach.
branches.cn: 标准与法律线：勉强够格、通知与救济各有一条必须达到的线。

intro.en: Adequate is the Latin prefix ad- plus the verb for making equal; the family keeps the same measuring image in adequacy and inadequate.
intro.cn: adequate 是拉丁前缀 ad- 加「使相等」动词；词族在 adequacy 与 inadequate 中保留同一量度意象。

latinIntro.en: Latin aequus, aequare and adaequatus are recorded; only the deeper origin of aequus is reconstructed and uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 aequus、aequare 与 adaequatus 均有记录；只有 aequus 更早的来源属于重构且不确定。

items.example: It brings aequare up to a standard.
items.exampleCN: 它把 aequare 提到某个标准上。

items.meaningCN: 平的；均等的；相等的；公平的
items.example: It is the root of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 它是整个词族的根。

items.example: It turns the adjective into an action.
items.exampleCN: 它把形容词变成动作。

items.example: It is the direct parent of adequate.
items.exampleCN: 它是 adequate 的直接母词。

items.example: English took the participle as an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 英语把这个分词借作形容词。

items.example: It appears at the end of adequate.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 adequate 的词尾。

items.example: It forms adequacy.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 adequacy。

items.example: It forms adequately.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 adequately。

definition_zh: 调整（设置）；适应新环境；校准（钟表）；整理（衣物）；调节（温度）；调解差异；保险理算；心理调适
definition_en: to change something slightly, or to change oneself, so that it fits better or works correctly
core_image: 把一枚歪斜的指针轻轻拨回正中的刻度
scene: 搬进新宿舍的第一周，他慢慢习惯了熄灯时间和室友的作息。It took him a week to adjust to the lights-out rule in the new dormitory.
sceneCN: 这里 adjust 是「适应新环境」（第 2 个义项：adjust to）；句意为他花了一周才适应新宿舍的熄灯规定。

pos.zh: 及物动词：调整；校准；整理；理算
不及物动词：适应；调节自身

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀 -ment 构成，义为「调整；适应；理算」
由本词加形容词后缀 -able 构成，义为「可调节的」
由本词加施动后缀 -er 构成，义为「调节器；理算师」
由 adjustable 加名词后缀 -ity 构成，义为「可调节性」
由本词加前缀 re- 构成，义为「重新调整」

senses.title: To change a setting slightly
senses.definition: to change the setting of a device or system a little so that it works better
senses.definitionCN: 小幅改变装置或系统的设置，使其运作得更好
senses.example: She adjusted the volume on the radio.
senses.exampleCN: 她调了调收音机的音量。
senses.why: The image nudges a crooked needle back to the right mark.
senses.whyCN: 意象是把歪斜的指针轻轻拨回正确的刻度。

senses.title: To become used to new conditions
senses.definition: to change one's habits or expectations in order to live or work well in new conditions
senses.definitionCN: 改变自己的习惯或期待，以便在新条件下生活或工作得宜
senses.example: It took him a week to adjust to the new dormitory.
senses.exampleCN: 他花了一周才适应新宿舍。
senses.why: The needle is the person, and the new surroundings are the mark it must reach.
senses.whyCN: 指针就是人，新环境是它必须对准的刻度。

senses.title: To set an instrument to a standard
senses.definition: to set a watch, gauge or instrument so that it agrees with an official standard
senses.definitionCN: 调准手表、仪表或仪器，使其与官方标准一致
senses.example: He adjusted his watch to the station clock.
senses.exampleCN: 他照车站的钟校准了手表。
senses.why: This is the core image made exact: one needle is brought into line with another.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心意象的精确版：一枚指针被拨到与另一枚对齐。

senses.title: To arrange clothing or hair neatly
senses.titleCN: 整理：把衣物或头发弄整齐
senses.definition: to pull clothing, a tie or hair into a neat or comfortable position
senses.definitionCN: 把衣服、领带或头发拉到整齐或舒适的位置
senses.example: She adjusted her scarf before entering the room.
senses.exampleCN: 进房间前她整了整围巾。
senses.why: The body is the instrument, and the cloth is the needle to be set right.
senses.whyCN: 身体是仪器，衣物是要被拨正的指针。

senses.title: To regulate a level such as heat
senses.definition: to regulate the level of heat, light, sound or another measurable quantity
senses.definitionCN: 调节热度、光线、声音或其他可测量的量
senses.example: Adjust the heating to a comfortable level.
senses.exampleCN: 把暖气调到舒适的温度。
senses.why: A dial is turned until the needle sits where the body needs it.
senses.whyCN: 转动旋钮，直到指针停在身体需要的刻度上。

senses.title: To settle a difference or balance
senses.titleCN: 调解差异：使双方或账目平衡
senses.definition: to settle a disagreement or bring accounts and figures into balance
senses.definitionCN: 平息分歧，或使账目与数字恢复平衡
senses.example: The two sides adjusted their differences before signing.
senses.exampleCN: 双方在签署前调解了分歧。
senses.why: Two needles that did not agree are brought to the same line.
senses.whyCN: 两枚不一致的指针被拨到同一条线上。

senses.title: To assess an insurance claim
senses.titleCN: 保险理算：核定并处理索赔
senses.definition: in insurance, to assess the loss and settle the amount payable on a claim
senses.definitionCN: 在保险中核定损失并确定索赔应付的金额
senses.example: The insurer adjusted the claim within ten days.
senses.exampleCN: 保险公司在十天内理算了这项索赔。
senses.why: A sum is brought into line with the loss, like a needle set to a mark.
senses.whyCN: 赔款被调到与损失相称，就像指针被拨到刻度。

senses.title: To adapt emotionally to a change
senses.definition: to adapt emotionally and mentally to a new situation, loss or routine
senses.definitionCN: 在情绪与心理上适应新的处境、失去或日常安排
senses.example: Older patients often need time to adjust after a move.
senses.exampleCN: 年长的病人搬家后往往需要时间做心理调适。
senses.why: The inner needle also needs time to settle at a new mark.
senses.whyCN: 内心的指针也需要时间，才能停在一个新的刻度上。

intro.en: Adjust comes from a French phrase meaning according to justice, and its oldest sense was to set something right rather than to fine-tune it.
intro.cn: adjust 来自意为「依照公正」的法语短语，最早义项是「把某物摆正」，而不是精细微调。

items.en: justus meant 'just, lawful, rightful', from ius 'law, right'.
items.cn: justus 意为「公正的、合法的、正当的」，来自 ius「法、权利」。

items.en: juste meant 'just, exact, correct', and it kept both the moral and the measuring sense.
items.cn: juste 意为「公正的、精确的、正确的」，同时保留道德与量度两层意思。

items.en: The phrase a juste, 'according to justice or exact measure', produced ajuster, 'to set right, fit, arrange'.
items.cn: 短语 a juste「依照公正或精确尺度」产生 ajuster，义为「摆正、使合适、安排」。

items.en: English borrowed ajuster as ajusten or adjust; the exact first record is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语借入 ajuster 作 ajusten 或 adjust；确切首见记录不确定。

items.en: The word spread from setting things right to instruments, clothing, temperatures, accounts and finally emotional fit.
items.cn: 这个词从「把东西摆正」扩展到仪器、衣物、温度、账目，最后到情绪上的适应。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the English family built on adjust; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of small changes made to fit or to standard.
note.cn: 形近组收由 adjust 构成的英语词族；近义组收表示为合身或达标而作小幅改动的动词。

entries.definition: The noun for a small change made to fit or to work better.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「调整、调节」，指为合适或更好运作所作的小改动。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning able to be changed in position or level.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「可调节的」，指位置或水平可以改变。

entries.definition: A device that regulates something, or a person who settles insurance claims.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「调节器；理算师」，指调节某物的装置或核定保险索赔的人。

entries.definition: A verb meaning to adjust again after a first change.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「重新调整」，指第一次调整之后再次调整。

entries.definition: To change oneself or something to fit new conditions, with more emphasis on a new environment.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「适应、改编」，更强调新环境。

entries.definition: To change something in part, often deliberately and for a stated aim.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「修改」，常指有意的部分改动。

entries.definition: To set an instrument precisely against a known standard, a narrower word than adjust.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「校准」，指按已知标准精确调准仪器，比 adjust 更窄。

entries.definition: To control or keep something at a steady level, such as heat or speed.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「调节、控制」，使热度或速度等保持在稳定水平。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real French phrase for exact measure and the many fields where adjust is now used.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的法语「精确尺度」短语，以及 adjust 如今使用的多个领域。

normal.en: a juste means according to justice: to adjust is to set something right.
normal.cn: a juste 意为「依照公正」：adjust 就是把某物摆正。

normal.en: The same word fits a watch, a scarf, a thermostat and a claim.
normal.cn: 同一个词可以用于手表、围巾、恒温器和保险索赔。

normal.en: Adjust to is intransitive: the person moves, not the place.
normal.cn: adjust to 是不及物用法：动的是人，不是地方。

normal.en: An adjuster brings a claim into line with the loss.
normal.cn: adjuster 把赔款调到与损失相称。

normal.en: A crooked needle is the whole picture: nudge it back to the mark.
normal.cn: 歪掉的指针就是全部图景：把它轻轻拨回刻度。

abstract.en: Picture a dial with a needle slightly off centre, and a finger giving it the smallest turn.
abstract.cn: 想象一个指针稍稍偏离中心的表盘，一根手指给它最小的转动。

abstract.en: The same small turn can fix a radio, a watch, a scarf or a quarrel.
abstract.cn: 同样的小小转动可以修正收音机、手表、围巾或一场争吵。

abstract.en: When the instrument is a person, adjusting takes weeks rather than seconds.
abstract.cn: 当仪器是一个人时，调整需要数周，而不是几秒。

examples.en: You can adjust the chair to a lower height.
examples.cn: 你可以把椅子调到更低的高度。

examples.en: It takes time to adjust to a new job.
examples.cn: 适应一份新工作需要时间。

examples.en: The company adjusted the claim after the storm.
examples.cn: 暴风雨过后，公司理算了索赔。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿贾斯特」——阿贾把歪掉的指针轻轻拨回正中：调整、校准

root: 古法语 ajuster 出自短语 a juste「依照公正或精确尺度」，juste 来自拉丁 justus「公正的、合法的」，而 justus 又出自 ius「法、权利」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of adjust all turn a needle back to its mark: a device setting, a new environment, a standard instrument, clothing, heat, a difference, an insurance claim, and the emotions.
sensesIntro.cn: adjust 的八个义项都是把指针拨回刻度：装置设置、新环境、标准仪器、衣物、温度、分歧、保险索赔，以及情绪。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger gives a crooked needle the smallest turn back to the centre mark.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根手指把歪斜的指针轻轻拨回中心刻度。

branches.en: SETTING: volume and heat are tuned until the level is right.
branches.cn: 设置线：音量与热度被调到合适水平。

branches.en: FIT: a person, outwardly or inwardly, settles at a new mark.
branches.cn: 适应线：人在外在或内心里停到一个新的刻度上。

branches.en: STANDARD: a watch is brought into line with an official clock.
branches.cn: 标准线：手表被拨到与官方时钟一致。

branches.en: APPEARANCE: a scarf or collar is pulled straight.
branches.cn: 仪容线：围巾或衣领被拉正。

branches.en: BALANCE: differences and claims are brought into line with what is right.
branches.cn: 平衡线：分歧与索赔被调到与应然相称。

intro.en: Adjust is a French phrase turned into a verb; the jus- root for law and right also gives justice and just.
intro.cn: adjust 是一个法语短语变成的动词；表示「法、正当」的 jus- 词根还给出 justice 与 just。

latinIntro.en: Latin ius, justus and justitia are recorded; the French verb ajuster is not Latin and is dated only from Old French.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ius、justus 与 justitia 均有记录；法语动词 ajuster 并非拉丁语，只能上溯到古法语。

items.example: In French it appears as a before juste.
items.exampleCN: 在法语中它写作 a，置于 juste 之前。

items.example: It is the deepest root of the family.
items.exampleCN: 它是这一词族最深的根。

items.example: It supplies the measuring sense of exactness.
items.exampleCN: 它提供「精确」这一量度含义。

items.example: It is the word inside the phrase a juste.
items.exampleCN: 它是短语 a juste 中的那个词。

items.example: It is the direct source of adjust.
items.exampleCN: 它是 adjust 的直接来源。

items.example: It forms adjustment.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 adjustment。

items.exampleCN: 它构成 adjustable。

definition_zh: 调整；调节装置；适应过程；心理调适；保险理算；工资或价格的调整；校准；对……的适应
definition_en: a small change made to something so that it fits, works correctly, or suits a new situation
core_image: 把歪了的桌腿一点点垫平：拧动螺栓，让物件重新贴合地面
scene: 车间的老机床跑偏了，师傅停下车床，俯身去拧底座上的螺栓。He made a small adjustment to the base of the machine and the vibration stopped.
sceneCN: 这里 adjustment 是「调整动作」（第 1 个义项：为使某物更合适而做的小改动）；句意为他对机器底座做了小幅调整，震动便停止了。

pos.zh: 名词：调整；调节装置；适应；理算

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉名词后缀 -ment 得到的动词，义为「调整；调节；适应」
由 adjust 加形容词后缀 -able 构成，义为「可调整的」
由 adjust 加表示施动者的后缀 -er 构成，义为「调节器；理算员」
由前缀 re- 加本词构成，义为「重新调整；再适应」
由前缀 mal-「坏」加本词构成，义为「适应不良；失调」

senses.title: A small change made to a thing
senses.titleCN: 调整动作：对物件的小改动
senses.definition: a small change made to a device, plan, or arrangement so that it works or fits better
senses.definitionCN: 为使装置、计划或安排运转得更好或更贴合而做的小改动
senses.example: A slight adjustment to the seat made the long drive comfortable.
senses.exampleCN: 对座椅做了轻微调整，长途驾驶就舒服了。
senses.why: The core image is a tilted table leg being padded: a small turn of the bolt, and the thing sits level again.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是垫平歪斜的桌腿：螺栓只转了一点，物件便重新稳稳落地。

senses.title: A part that regulates a mechanism
senses.titleCN: 调节装置：机器上的可调部件
senses.definition: a part or mechanism used to set, tune, or regulate a machine or instrument
senses.definitionCN: 用来设定、微调或调节机器、仪器的部件或机构
senses.example: Turn the adjustment at the side of the lamp to change its angle.
senses.exampleCN: 转动灯侧面的调节装置就能改变角度。
senses.why: If the act of turning can level a thing, the part you turn becomes the adjustment itself.
senses.whyCN: 既然「拧动」能让物件归位，那么被拧动的那个部件本身也就被叫作 adjustment。

senses.title: The process of settling into a new situation
senses.titleCN: 适应过程：迁入新环境的过渡
senses.definition: the process of getting used to a new place, job, school, or set of conditions
senses.definitionCN: 逐渐熟悉新地方、新工作、新学校或新条件的过程
senses.example: Moving abroad involves a long period of adjustment.
senses.exampleCN: 移居国外需要一段很长的适应期。
senses.why: The table leg is now a person: the small changes are made inside a life until it fits its new ground.
senses.whyCN: 这里的桌腿换成了人：一点一点的改变发生在生活内部，直到它与新的地面贴合。

senses.title: Emotional adjustment
senses.titleCN: 心理调适：情绪上的重新平衡
senses.definition: the mental process of coping with stress, loss, or a changed circumstance
senses.definitionCN: 应对压力、失落或环境变化时的心理调适过程
senses.example: Counsellors help students with the emotional adjustment to college.
senses.exampleCN: 辅导员帮助学生应对进入大学后的情绪调适。
senses.why: When the thing being levelled is the mind, the change is made in feelings rather than in wood or metal.
senses.whyCN: 当被垫平的对象是心灵时，改动就发生在情绪里，而不是木头或金属里。

senses.title: Insurance loss adjustment
senses.titleCN: 保险理算：核定赔付金额
senses.definition: the assessment of an insurance claim in order to decide how much the insurer must pay
senses.definitionCN: 对保险索赔进行核定，以确定保险人应赔付多少
senses.example: The insurance adjustment reduced the claim by half.
senses.exampleCN: 保险理算把索赔金额削减了一半。
senses.why: A damaged claim is balanced against a policy: the assessor turns the figures until the two sides agree.
senses.whyCN: 受损的索赔要与保单相衡：理算员反复拨动数字，直到两边对得上。

senses.title: An official change in wages or prices
senses.definition: an official change in the level of pay, prices, or benefits, usually made at set intervals
senses.definitionCN: 对工资、价格或福利水平的正式调整，通常按固定周期进行
senses.example: The annual wage adjustment raised every salary by three percent.
senses.exampleCN: 年度工资调整把每份薪水都提高了三个百分点。
senses.why: Whole figures can be levelled too: the same small turn is applied to a rate that has drifted out of line.
senses.whyCN: 整组数字也能被垫平：同一个「拧一拧」的动作，用在已经偏离轨道的费率上。

senses.title: Calibration of an instrument
senses.definition: the act of setting an instrument or measuring device so that its readings are accurate
senses.definitionCN: 调整仪器或测量装置，使其读数重新准确的动作
senses.example: The adjustment of the scale took two careful hours.
senses.exampleCN: 校准这台天平花了两个小时，做得很仔细。
senses.why: Here the standard is accuracy itself: the instrument is turned until its pointer and the true measure coincide.
senses.whyCN: 这里的标准就是精确：仪器被反复调校，直到指针与真实量值重合。

senses.title: Adjustment to a physical condition
senses.titleCN: 对……的适应：与特定条件相合
senses.definition: in the phrase adjustment to, the process of becoming suited to a particular physical or external condition
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 adjustment to，表示逐渐与某种身体条件或外部条件相适应的过程
senses.example: The adjustment to high altitude can cause headaches at first.
senses.exampleCN: 初到高海拔地区时，对环境的适应可能引起头痛。
senses.why: The phrase names the ground the thing must fit: adjustment to altitude, to cold, to a new rhythm.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语点明了物件必须贴合的那块地面：适应海拔、适应寒冷、适应新的作息。

intro.en: Adjustment is the noun built on adjust, a verb borrowed from Old French and usually explained through the idea of making something exact.
intro.cn: adjustment 是在动词 adjust 之上加名词后缀构成的名词；adjust 借自古法语，一般解释为「使某物变得精确、合适」。

items.en: The adverb juxta meant 'near, close by', from a root often connected with joining; the deeper origin is source uncertain.
items.cn: 副词 juxta 意为「在近旁」，其词根常被认为与「连接」有关；更早的来源不确定。

items.en: Old French adjuster, also written ajouster, meant 'to arrange, set in order'. It is usually analysed as a- plus juste 'just, exact', though a link to Latin juxta has also been proposed.
items.cn: 古法语 adjuster（也写作 ajouster）意为「安排、整理」。一般认为它由 a- 加 juste「公正、精确」构成，也有学者把它联系到拉丁语 juxta。

items.en: The verb entered English in the fourteenth or fifteenth century with the sense 'to arrange, settle, harmonize'; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 这个动词在十四或十五世纪进入英语，意为「安排、安顿、使协调」；确切的首见年代不确定。

items.en: The noun adjustment joins the verb to the French and Latin suffix -ment, which marks an act or its result.
items.cn: 名词 adjustment 由动词加法语、拉丁语来源的后缀 -ment 构成，该后缀表示动作或其结果。

items.en: The noun widened from arranging objects to adapting people, tuning machines, changing pay rates, and settling insurance claims.
items.cn: 这个名词从「整理物件」扩展到人的适应、机器的调校、工资的变动以及保险索赔的核定。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms built on the same adjust base; the near-meaning group gathers other words for change, fit, and measurement.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 adjust 词基构成的一族词；近义组收其他表示改变、适配与测量的词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to change something slightly so that it fits or works better.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「调整、调节」，即小幅改变某物使其更合适或运转更好。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning able to be changed or set in different positions.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「可调整的」，指能够改变或调到不同位置。

entries.definition: A noun for a person who assesses insurance claims, or a device that regulates something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「理算员」或「调节器」，指核定索赔的人或起调节作用的装置。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to adjust again after a first change.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「重新调整」，指在第一次改动之后再次调节。

entries.definition: A noun meaning a failure to adapt to one's circumstances.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「适应不良、失调」，指未能与所处环境相适应。

entries.definition: The process of changing in order to suit a new environment; broader and often slower than an adjustment.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「适应、改编」，强调为适合新环境而改变，范围更宽、过程常更慢。

entries.definition: A change made to something, often a more deliberate and structural one.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「修改、改动」，通常指更有意为之、幅度更大的改动。

entries.definition: The exact setting of an instrument against a standard, narrower than adjustment.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「校准」，指依标准精确设定仪器，范围比 adjustment 更窄。

entries.definition: A change in form or character, with no idea of fitting or tuning.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「改变、改动」，只强调形态或性质变化，不含「调适、校准」的意思。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Old French base and the word family that grows from adjust.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的古法语词基，以及由 adjust 长出的整个词族。

normal.en: The verb adjust is borrowed from Old French, and the noun simply adds -ment.
normal.cn: 动词 adjust 借自古法语，名词只是在它后面加 -ment。

normal.en: Juste inside adjust carries exactness: to adjust is to make something exact.
normal.cn: adjust 里的 juste 带着「精确」的意思：adjust 就是把某物调到精确。

normal.en: Adjustable, adjuster and readjustment keep the same base; only the suffixes differ.
normal.cn: adjustable、adjuster、readjustment 都保留同一个词基，只是后缀不同。

normal.en: A wage adjustment changes pay, while an insurance adjustment settles a claim.
normal.cn: wage adjustment 改变的是工资，insurance adjustment 结清的是索赔。

normal.en: The phrase adjustment to always names the condition that a person or thing must fit.
normal.cn: 短语 adjustment to 总是点明人或物必须去贴合的那个条件。

abstract.en: Picture an old table with one short leg: a few turns of the bolt, and the top is level again.
abstract.cn: 想象一张旧桌子有一条短腿：螺栓转几下，桌面就重新水平了。

abstract.en: Change the table for a person in a new city: the same small turns happen inside the life.
abstract.cn: 把桌子换成一个初到新城市的人：同样的小幅转动发生在他的生活里。

abstract.en: Change it again for a scale or a salary: anything out of line can be brought back into line.
abstract.cn: 再把它换成一架天平或一份薪水：任何偏离轨道的对象都能被调回轨道。

examples.en: A slight adjustment to the seat made the whole journey pleasant.
examples.cn: 对座椅稍作调整，整段旅程就变得舒适了。

examples.en: The company announced a wage adjustment for all staff.
examples.cn: 公司宣布对所有员工进行工资调整。

examples.en: Her adjustment to the new school took most of the autumn.
examples.cn: 她花了整个秋天来适应新学校。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额贾斯特门特」——师傅蹲下身，拧一拧、垫一垫，机器就重新合身了

root: adjust 借自古法语 adjuster「安排、整理」，一般认为由 a-「向」加 juste「公正、精确」构成，juste 又来自拉丁语 justus，与 ius「权利、法」相关；也有解释把它联系到拉丁语 juxta「在近旁」。再加名词后缀 -ment 构成 adjustment。更早的印欧词根存疑。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses apply one small act of levelling: to an object, to its regulating part, to a person settling in, to the mind, to a claim, to a rate, to an instrument, and to a specific condition.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在施加同一个「小幅归位」的动作：用在物件、调节部件、人的安顿、心理、索赔、费率、仪器，以及某个特定条件上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tilted leg is padded a little at a time until the whole thing stands level.
core.cn: 核心意象：歪斜的桌腿被一点一点垫平，直到整个物件重新站稳。

branches.en: THE OBJECT: a small change and the part that is turned to make it hold.
branches.cn: 物件线：一次小改动，以及被拧动的那个部件。

branches.en: THE PERSON: getting used to a place, or suiting a particular physical condition.
branches.cn: 人的线：适应一个新地方，或与某种身体条件相合。

branches.en: THE MIND: the same levelling happens in feelings rather than in wood or metal.
branches.cn: 心理线：同样的归位发生在情绪里，而不是木头或金属里。

branches.en: THE MONEY: claims and pay rates are brought back into line by the same small turns.
branches.cn: 金钱线：索赔与工资费率也靠同样的小幅拨动被调回轨道。

branches.en: THE INSTRUMENT: accuracy is the ground, and the pointer is turned until it touches it.
branches.cn: 仪器线：精确就是那块地面，指针被调到与它相接。

intro.en: Adjustment is a French borrowing dressed with Latin suffixes; the word is not built from English parts alone.
intro.cn: adjustment 是借自法语的词，再加上拉丁语来源的后缀；它并非只用英语部件构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin words behind the family are juxta, justus and ius, all recorded; only the deeper root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 这一词族背后的拉丁词 juxta、justus、ius 都有文献记录，只有更早的词根属于重构形式。

items.example: It is the source of the idea of placing things side by side.
items.exampleCN: 它是「把事物并排放置」这一观念的来源。

items.example: It forms adjustable.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 adjustable。

items.example: It forms adjuster.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 adjuster。

items.example: It forms readjust.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 readjust。

items.example: It forms maladjustment.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 maladjustment。

definition_zh: 行政管理；政府；管理行为；执行、实施；给药；企业管理层；行政机构；遗产管理
definition_en: the work of managing the affairs of an organization or state, or the body of people who carry it out
core_image: 一间办公室里的长桌：文件从一只手传到另一只手，被逐项登记、分配、执行
scene: 县政务大厅里，取号机前排起长队，墙上的流程图画得很细。The administration of the county keeps every application on file.
sceneCN: 这里 administration 是「行政管理」（第 1 个义项：管理公共事务的活动）；句意为该县的行政管理把每一份申请都存档。

pos.zh: 名词：行政管理；政府；管理行为；执行；给药；遗产管理

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉名词后缀 -ation 得到的动词，义为「管理；执行；给予（药物）」
由 administer 加形容词后缀 -ative 构成，义为「行政的；管理上的」
由 administer 加表示施动者的后缀 -ator 构成，义为「管理者；行政人员」
由拉丁词基 ministr- 加名词后缀 -ation 构成，义为「服务；照料；仪式」
由 administrative 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「在行政上」

senses.title: The running of public or institutional affairs
senses.titleCN: 行政管理：公共事务的组织运作
senses.definition: the activity of managing and organizing the affairs of an institution, system, or state
senses.definitionCN: 管理和组织机构、系统或国家事务的活动
senses.example: She studied public administration at university.
senses.exampleCN: 她在大学学习公共行政。
senses.why: The core image is a desk where papers are registered and passed on: running affairs means keeping that desk moving.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一张登记、转交文件的办公桌：所谓管理事务，就是让这张桌子一直运转。

senses.title: The government in power
senses.definition: the government of a country, especially when referred to by the name of its leader
senses.definitionCN: 一个国家的政府，尤指以其领导人姓名来称呼时
senses.example: The administration promised to cut taxes within a year.
senses.exampleCN: 该政府承诺一年内减税。
senses.why: The desk that runs the whole country becomes a name for the people sitting behind it.
senses.whyCN: 管理整个国家的那张办公桌，转喻为坐在它后面的那批人。

senses.title: The act of managing resources
senses.titleCN: 管理行为：对资源与事务的调度
senses.definition: the act of directing the use of money, property, or staff in an organized way
senses.definitionCN: 有条理地调度资金、财产或人员的行为
senses.example: The administration of the fund requires careful records.
senses.exampleCN: 这项基金的管理需要仔细的账目记录。
senses.why: Here the noun names the act itself, not the office or the people: the passing of papers is seen as one motion.
senses.whyCN: 这里名词指的是行为本身，而不是办公室或那批人：文件的传递被看作一个连续动作。

senses.title: The carrying out of law or justice
senses.definition: the act of putting a law, a system, or justice into effect
senses.definitionCN: 让法律、制度或司法得以施行、生效的行为
senses.example: The administration of justice must be fair and public.
senses.exampleCN: 司法的执行必须公正且公开。
senses.why: A law on paper is a document waiting on the desk; administration is the hand that finally carries it out.
senses.whyCN: 纸上的法律只是等在桌上的文件；administration 就是最终把它执行下去的那只手。

senses.title: The giving of medicine
senses.definition: the act of giving a drug or treatment to a patient in a controlled way
senses.definitionCN: 以受控方式把药物或治疗给予病人的行为
senses.example: The nurse recorded the administration of the drug at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 护士记录了正午时分的给药。
senses.why: The same verb that manages affairs also means to give: a dose is handed out as carefully as a document.
senses.whyCN: 同一个表示「管理」的动词也有「给予」义：一剂药被分发得像一份文件一样谨慎。

senses.title: The management layer of a company
senses.definition: the group of people who manage an organization, as opposed to its ordinary workers
senses.definitionCN: 管理一个组织的那批人，与普通员工相对
senses.example: The administration met the union on Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 管理层在周五与工会会面。
senses.why: The desk stands for those seated at it: the managers are named by the work they do.
senses.whyCN: 办公桌代指坐在桌边的人：管理者是以他们所做的事来命名的。

senses.title: An official agency or body
senses.titleCN: 行政机构：承担公共职能的部门
senses.definition: an official body that carries out public policy in a particular field
senses.definitionCN: 在某一领域执行公共政策的官方机构
senses.example: The port administration controls all shipping in the bay.
senses.exampleCN: 港务管理机构掌控海湾内的全部航运。
senses.why: A single desk grows into a whole office: the activity hardens into an institution with a name.
senses.whyCN: 一张办公桌长成了一整间办公室：这项活动凝固成一个有名号的机构。

senses.title: The legal handling of an estate
senses.definition: the legal process of settling and distributing the property of a person who has died
senses.definitionCN: 清理并分配死者财产的法律程序
senses.example: The court granted her letters of administration over the estate.
senses.exampleCN: 法院授予她管理该遗产的授权书。
senses.why: Even a dead person's property needs a desk: someone must list, value and hand out what remains.
senses.whyCN: 连死者的财产也需要一张办公桌：必须有人清点、估价并分配留下的东西。

intro.en: Administration comes straight from Latin administratio, a noun built on the verb 'to serve', not on any word for ruling.
intro.cn: administration 直接来自拉丁语 administratio，这个名词建立在表示「服务」的动词上，而不是建立在任何表示「统治」的词上。

items.en: *mei- is generally reconstructed as 'small, little', the root behind Latin minus; the deeper history of the root is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧语 *mei- 表示「小、少」，是拉丁语 minus 背后的词根；该词根更早的历史不确定。

items.en: minus meant 'less'; from it came minister, 'servant, attendant', usually explained as 'the lesser one'.
items.cn: minus 意为「更少」；由它生出 minister「仆人、侍从」，一般解释为「地位较低者」。

items.en: ad- 'to' plus ministrare 'to serve' gave administrare, 'to serve, manage, carry out'.
items.cn: ad-「向」加 ministrare「服务」构成 administrare，意为「服务、管理、执行」。

items.en: The noun administratio named service, management, and the carrying out of public affairs.
items.cn: 名词 administratio 表示服务、管理以及公共事务的执行。

items.en: Borrowed through French, the word first meant the management of affairs and later also the governing body itself.
items.cn: 这个词经法语借入英语，最初指事务的管理，后来也指执政机构本身。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the minister root; the near-meaning group gathers other terms for management and governing.
note.cn: 形近组收由 minister 词根构成的一族词；近义组收其他表示管理与治理的词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to manage affairs or to give a drug or treatment.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「管理事务」或「给予药物、治疗」。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning relating to the managing of an organization.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「行政的、管理上的」，指与组织管理有关。

entries.definition: A noun for a person who manages an institution or system.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「管理者、行政人员」，指管理某机构或系统的人。

entries.definition: A noun meaning the giving of help or care, often in a religious setting.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「服务、照料」，常用于宗教语境。

entries.definition: A noun for a government department or the work of a religious minister.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「政府部门」或「牧师职责」，同出 minister 词根。

entries.definition: The act of running a business or team; more commercial than administration.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「管理、经营」，多用于企业与团队，商业色彩比 administration 更浓。

entries.definition: The manner of ruling a country or organization; abstract and formal.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「治理、管治方式」，指统治国家或组织的方式，抽象而正式。

entries.definition: The group of people who rule a country; close to the political sense of administration.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「政府」，指统治国家的那批人，与 administration 的政治义接近。

entries.definition: A system or government, often used with disapproval of its methods.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「政权、制度」，常带对其手段不以为然的意味。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin verb 'to serve' and the family that grows from minister.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁动词「服务」，以及由 minister 长出的词族。

normal.en: The Latin verb administrare means to serve, and service is the oldest layer of the word.
normal.cn: 拉丁动词 administrare 意为「服务」，而「服务」正是这个词最古老的层次。

normal.en: Minister, ministry and ministration all descend from the same servant word.
normal.cn: minister、ministry、ministration 都来自同一个表示「仆人」的词。

normal.en: To administer a drug is to hand out a dose in the same careful way as a document.
normal.cn: administer a drug 是把一剂药像文件一样谨慎地分发出去。

normal.en: Public administration is the running of state affairs, not the making of laws.
normal.cn: public administration 是打理国家事务，而不是制定法律。

normal.en: Letters of administration give a person the legal right to settle an estate.
normal.cn: letters of administration 授予某人清理遗产的法定权利。

abstract.en: Picture a long desk with in-trays: every paper enters on the left and leaves on the right, registered and carried out.
abstract.cn: 想象一张摆着文件盘的长桌：每份文件从左边进来、从右边出去，被登记、被执行。

abstract.en: The same desk is a government when the papers concern a whole country, and a company when they concern a firm.
abstract.cn: 同一张桌子，处理全国事务时就是政府，处理一家公司事务时就是管理层。

abstract.en: Service is the quiet centre: administration began as waiting on others, and it still means carrying out their affairs.
abstract.cn: 「服务」是安静的核心：administration 最初就是侍奉他人，至今仍指替他人把事情办成。

examples.en: Good administration depends on clear records and fair rules.
examples.cn: 良好的行政管理依赖清晰的记录与公正的规则。

examples.en: The hospital administration approved the new ward last month.
examples.cn: 医院管理层上个月批准了新病房。

examples.en: Letters of administration were granted to the eldest son.
examples.cn: 遗产管理授权书被授予了长子。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额的迷你斯特雷申」——一叠文件在长桌上被逐份登记、分发、执行

root: 拉丁语 administratio 由 administrare「服务、管理、执行」构成，后者是 ad-「向」加 ministrare「服务」，而 ministrare 又来自 minister「仆人」，一般认为与 minus「更少」有关，含「地位较低者」之意。原始印欧语 *mei-「小、少」为重构形式，更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all keep the same desk in view: the work, the people, the act, the carrying out, the dosing, the managers, the agency, and the settling of an estate.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都守着同一张办公桌：工作本身、坐在桌后的人、管理行为、执行、给药、管理者、机构，以及遗产的清理。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long desk where papers are registered, passed from hand to hand, and finally carried out.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张长办公桌，文件在此登记、逐手传递，最终被执行。

branches.en: THE DESK: running affairs, the act of managing, and the managers who sit behind it.
branches.cn: 办公桌线：打理事务、管理行为，以及坐在桌后的管理者。

branches.en: THE BODY: the government in power and the agencies that carry out its policy.
branches.cn: 机构线：执政的政府，以及执行其政策的行政机构。

branches.en: THE LAW: a statute is carried out, and justice is administered in public.
branches.cn: 法律线：法令被施行，司法被执行于公众面前。

branches.en: THE DOSE: the same verb of handing out applies to medicine given to a patient.
branches.cn: 药剂线：同一个「分发」动词，也用在给予病人的药物上。

branches.en: THE ESTATE: even the property of the dead is listed, valued, and handed on.
branches.cn: 遗产线：连死者的财产也要被清点、估价并移交。

intro.en: Administration is Latin from end to end, built from a prefix, a service root, and a noun suffix.
intro.cn: administration 从头到尾都来自拉丁语，由前缀、表示「服务」的词根与名词后缀构成。

latinIntro.en: Minister, ministrare, administrare and administratio are all recorded Latin words, so only the Indo-European root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: minister、ministrare、administrare、administratio 都是有记录的拉丁词，只有印欧词根属于重构形式。
